posts.title: INEC rejects 64 petitions, removes candidates from 2027 election lists
posts.excerpt: The Independent National Electoral Commission, INEC, has rejected 64 petitions filed by political parties over the 2027 governorship and State Houses of Assembly candidates’ lists, following a review
posts.content:
The Independent National Electoral Commission, INEC, has rejected 64 petitions filed by political parties over the 2027 governorship and State Houses of Assembly candidates’ lists, following a review that also led to the removal of some candidates.

The commission disclosed this in a statement signed by Mohammed Kudu Haruna, Chairman of its Information and Voter Education Committee, on October 30, 2026.

INEC said 12 political parties filed 69 petitions across 26 states over governorship candidates.

It approved 41 of the complaints but dismissed 28.

For the State Houses of Assembly elections, 61 petitions were submitted by 11 political parties across 11 states.

The commission upheld 25 and rejected 36.

The complaints involved political parties allegedly omitted from the lists, candidates whose names were included despite not appearing in their parties’ membership registers, and cases of multiple nominations.

Following its review, INEC approved the inclusion of candidates and parties whose complaints were justified.

It also removed names that were wrongly published and candidates whose nominations did not meet legal requirements.

The commission said the revised lists would be published on its website, with details of the affected candidates, political parties and states.

“The Commission assures the public of its commitment to transparency and the credibility of the electoral process,” the statement added.

INEC rejects 64 petitions, removes candidates from 2027 election lists

Source: https://dailypost.ng/2026/10/30/inec-rejects-64-petitions-removes-candidates-from-2027-election-lists/

posts.title: SWAT recovers stolen unregistered Lexus in Ondo after Ogun robbery
posts.excerpt: The Special Weapons and Tactics, SWAT, Squad of the Ogun State Police Command has recovered a stolen unregistered Lexus ES350 saloon car in Ondo State. The recovery followed sustained intelligence-led
posts.content:
The Special Weapons and Tactics, SWAT, Squad of the Ogun State Police Command has recovered a stolen unregistered Lexus ES350 saloon car in Ondo State.

The recovery followed sustained intelligence-led efforts months after the vehicle was snatched by suspected armed robbers.

Police said the incident occurred on September 15, 2026, at about 2:00am in Ogijo area of Ogun State, where a red Lexus ES350 without registration number was stolen at gunpoint.

Confirming the recovery in a statement on Friday, the Police Public Relations Officer, Ogun State Command, DSP Oluseyi Babaseyi, said the Officer-in-Charge of SWAT, SP Obeh Eneye, directed operatives to commence an investigation immediately the report was received.

"Sustained investigative efforts subsequently led to the discovery of the vehicle in Ondo State. SWAT operatives facilitated its recovery and conveyed it to the Ogun State Police Command," Babaseyi said.

He said investigations are ongoing to apprehend other suspects connected with the incident and recover additional stolen property.

Meanwhile, the Commissioner of Police, Ogun State Command, CP Bode Ojajuni, has commended the SWAT operatives for their diligence and professionalism.

Ojajuni reaffirmed the Command's commitment to intelligence-led operations, recovery of stolen property and prosecution of offenders.

He urged vehicle owners to ensure their vehicles are duly registered and display valid registration numbers, noting that proper registration facilitates identification, ownership verification and tracing of stolen vehicles.

He also encouraged residents to promptly report suspicious activities and provide credible information to the police.

SWAT recovers stolen unregistered Lexus in Ondo after Ogun robbery

posts.title: 10 phones with biggest battery specs in Nigeria
posts.excerpt: By Prince Osuagwu The life of a Nigerian phone user is funny. With power cuts and long days on the road, battery life is no longer just a specification on a phone’s spec sheet, it is peace of mind.Thi
posts.content:
By Prince Osuagwu

The life of a Nigerian phone user is funny. With power cuts and long days on the road, battery life is no longer just a specification on a phone’s spec sheet, it is peace of mind. This is because, a dead phone can mean missed calls, stranded commutes and lost work.

So, for a user, searching for phones with the biggest battery specs is inevitable.

TechXtra now xrays some of the models to watch. The list ranks the phones by their listed battery capacity, starting with the first 10,000mAh smartphone available in Nigeria today.

REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G — 10,000mAh The REDMI Note 17 Pro Max 5G leads the pack with a 10,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, the largest listed capacity for a smartphone sold in Nigeria. The device combines the massive battery with 100W HyperCharge and up to 27W wired reverse charging. It also features a 6.83-inch 1.5K AMOLED display and 5G support.

REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G — 8,340mAh The REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G comes with an 8,340mAh silicon-carbon battery and 67W HyperCharge, as well as up to 22.5W wired reverse charging. It features a 6.83-inch 1.5K AMOLED display, Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 platform and IP66/IP68/IP69/IP69K ratings under specified test conditions.

realme C100 4G — 8,000mAh The realme C100 4G is listed on realme Nigeria’s website with an 8,000mAh Titan battery and 45W fast charging, alongside up to 10W reverse charging. The smartphone uses a 6.8-inch 120Hz display and MediaTek Helio G92 Max chipset and is available through Nigerian retail channels.

REDMI Note 17 — 7,700mAh The standard REDMI Note 17 carries a 7,700mAh silicon-carbon battery with 45W Turbo Charging and up to 22.5W wired reverse charging. Xiaomi Nigeria lists the phone with a 6.99-inch FHD+ AMOLED display, Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 platform and TÜV SÜD five-star battery performance certification.

REDMI 17 — 7,500mAh The REDMI 17 comes with a 7,500mAh typical battery, 45W Turbo Charging and up to 22.5W wired reverse charging. It is positioned as an accessible large-battery option within the REDMI 17 lineup and is available through Xiaomi Nigeria’s official channels and authorised partners.

Vivo Y31D — 7,200mAh The vivo Y31D packs a 7,200mAh typical BlueVolt battery with 44W FlashCharge and up to 6W reverse charging. The device is sold in Nigeria with a 6.75-inch 120Hz LCD, Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 4G platform and IP69-rated dust and water resistance.

TECNO Spark 50 — 7,000mAh The TECNO Spark 50 is listed with a 7,000mAh battery and 18W fast charging, targeting users seeking long daily battery life at an entry-level price. TECNO Nigeria describes it as one of its latest 2026 phones, with more than 28 hours of continuous video playback claimed under laboratory conditions.

itel A300+ — 7,000mAh The itel A300+ comes with a 7,000mAh battery and 22.5W fast charging, alongside a secondary 2.01-inch interactive rear display. It is sold in Nigeria with a 6.78-inch HD+ 120Hz LCD, Helio G81 Ultimate chipset, IP65 rating and Android 16 (Go Edition).

Infinix Hot 70 Pro — 7,000mAh The Infinix Hot 70 Pro is listed in Nigeria with a 7,000mAh battery and fast charging. It also features a 6.78-inch 120Hz IPS display and MediaTek Dimensity 7100 5G chipset and is officially available through Infinix Nigeria’s retail stores and major online platforms.

TECNO Spark 50 4G — 6,700mAh The TECNO Spark 50 4G variant is listed with a 6,700mAh battery and 18W fast charging, placing it below the 7,000mAh Spark 50 in the same series. The phone targets value-focused buyers who want a large battery combined with a modern display in an entry-level package. Big batteries become a selling point.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/10-phones-with-biggest-battery-specs-in-nigeria/

posts.title: Dollar to Naira exchange rate today, October 30, 2026
posts.excerpt: The Nigerian Naira opened today, Friday, October 30, 2026, holding firm against the United States Dollar across both the official foreign exchange window and the parallel market, following sustained l
posts.content:
The Nigerian Naira opened today, Friday, October 30, 2026, holding firm against the United States Dollar across both the official foreign exchange window and the parallel market, following sustained liquidity interventions by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and healthy diaspora inflows.

At the official Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market (NFEM), the spot exchange rate traded at N1,346.86 per dollar during early morning transactions. Commercial banks and corporate importers observed orderly liquidity conditions as FX demand for trade obligations, tuition fees, and capital repatriation continued to be met across authorized channels.

In the parallel market, commonly referred to as the black market, street traders and Bureau De Change operators across major economic centers, including Lagos, Abuja, and Kano, quoted buying rates around N1,375 per dollar, while selling rates hovered around N1,385 per dollar.

The price gap between the official market and the parallel window remains narrow. Financial analysts attribute the relative stability of the local currency to Nigeria’s solid foreign reserve buffer, which remains well above $55 billion, enabling the central bank to cushion short-term demand shocks and maintain stability across trading channels. Market experts expect trading to remain steady throughout the business day as routine demand is steadily absorbed by market liquidity.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/dollar-to-naira-exchange-rate-today-october-30-2026/

posts.title: PSC promotes 2 DIGs, 10 AIGs, 17 CPs, 3,800 others
posts.excerpt: By Kingsley Omonobi The Police Service Commission (PSC) has approved the promotion of more than 3,800 senior police officers, including two Deputy Inspectors-General of Police (DIGs), 10 Assistant Ins
posts.content:
By Kingsley Omonobi

The Police Service Commission (PSC) has approved the promotion of more than 3,800 senior police officers, including two Deputy Inspectors-General of Police (DIGs), 10 Assistant Inspectors-General of Police (AIGs) and 17 Commissioners of Police (CPs).

The promotions followed the officers’ successful participation in promotion examinations and oral interviews conducted by the commission.

A statement issued by the PSC on Thursday said the approvals were granted at its plenary meeting in Abuja, presided over by its Chairman, DIG Hashimu Salihu Argungu (rtd).

The two officers elevated to the rank of DIG are AIG Olaolu Adegbite, Head of INTERPOL National Central Bureau, Abuja, and AIG Dankombo F. Morris, who heads Zone 4 Headquarters, Makurdi.

Adegbite holds a BA in Russian Language from the University of Lagos and an MA in Philology from the Pushkin Institute, Moscow. He is a recipient of the national honour of Member of the Order of the Federal Republic (MFR), a member of the FBI National Academy Associates and an alumnus of Harvard Kennedy School.

He previously served as Director of Operations at the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC).

Morris, who hails from Gombe State, holds a BA in History from the University of Maiduguri and a Diploma in Police Science. He has served as Commissioner of Police in Adamawa State.

The 10 officers promoted from CP to AIG are Omosanyin Olusegun, CP Administration, FCID Annex, Ikoyi, Lagos; Ogbodo Ugobueze, CP Anti-Fraud, FCID Annex, Enugu; Ohagwu Felix Ndukwe, CP Ondo State; Taylor Lennox Olanrewaju, AIG/ES, Nigeria Police Cooperative; Regina Cosmas Udoette, CP GI, FCID Annex, Enugu; Afolabi Wilfred Olutokunbo, CP Abia State Command; Nwogoh Martin, CP Airwing; Shetima Jauro Mohammed, CP Nasarawa; Ibrahim D. Gotan, former CP Osun; and Danjuma I. Yahaya, CP GI, FCID Kaduna.

Those elevated to the rank of CP from Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) are Nache Bashir Liman, DC ZCID; Sirajo Lawal Salihu, DC FMIU; Ayeleye Adegboyega E., DC AHTU FCID; Isiaka O. Salau, DC SID Ibadan; Usman Shaik Adamu, DC CID Jos; Aminu Maiwada Garba, DC DFA NGS; Abdulkarim Musa Waziri, DC DFA Yobe; Muhammad Yusuf Adamu, DC Administration, FCID; Sani Adamu Nufawa, DC Inter School, Kwara State; Bello M. Adamu, DCA Zone 2; Okezie Chikezie C., DC Anti-Fraud FCID Abuja; Aminu Usman Gusau, DC DFA Katsina; Abiodun Onuoha, DC DFA Oyo; Salisu Bello Fago, DC DFA Zamfara; Adegoke A. Alani, DC CID Delta; Wuwa Auwal Muhammad, DC Airwing; and Benedict U. Agbo, DC Forensic.

The commission also approved the promotion of 85 officers from Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) to DCP.

posts.title: Three killed in midair helicopter collision near Oregon airport, authorities confirm
posts.excerpt: Two helicopters collided midair near McMinnville Municipal Airport in Oregon, crashing in a field and forcing highway closures as the FAA investigates.
posts.content:
Three people were killed when two helicopters collided midair near an Oregon airport Thursday afternoon, crashing in a field and prompting authorities to close a nearby highway.

A Robinson R22 helicopter and an Airbus H125 helicopter collided near McMinnville Municipal Airport around 2:15 p.m. local time, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) confirmed in a statement to Fox News Digital.

The Yamhill County Sheriff's Office confirmed Thursday that all three people aboard the helicopters died in the crash.

The two victims aboard the Robinson R22 helicopter were identified as 22-year-old flight instructor Maddie Aasbo, of Texas, and a student pilot from the United Kingdom, according to the sheriff's office. The student's identity is being withheld pending notification of next of kin.

The sole occupant of the Airbus helicopter was identified as Tyler Delane Sturdevant, 38, of Newberg, Oregon.

TWO NAVY JETS CRASH MIDAIR AS CREW SUCCESSFULLY EJECTS DURING IDAHO MILITARY BASE AIR SHOW

The collision occurred in a field off Oregon Route 233, about one mile west of Dayton, according to Oregon Department of Transportation spokesperson Mindy McCartt.

McCartt told Fox News Digital that the highway and some nearby county roads were closed at the request of emergency responders. She said there was no estimated reopening time.

DASHCAM VIDEO CAPTURES SMALL PLANE CRASHING ON SAN JOSE HIGHWAY, INJURING THREE ON BOARD, INCLUDING CHILD

McMinnville Airport Manager John Paskell told Fox News Digital that the collision occurred off airport property and did not disrupt airport operations. The airport remained open without closures or restrictions.

Paskell said he understood that both helicopters were based at the airport but could not confirm what activities they were conducting or how the collision occurred.

The FAA and National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) responded to the scene and are leading the ongoing investigation into the collision, according to the sheriff's office.

The cause of the collision has not been determined.

The Yamhill County Sheriff's Office and NTSB did not respond to Fox News Digital's requests for comment.

posts.title: Chili's customers suffer chemical burns after dangerous margarita mix-up
posts.excerpt: Three customers and two employees suffered symptoms after an industrial degreaser was mistakenly used to prepare margaritas at a North Carolina Chili's.
posts.content:
Multiple customers at a Chili's Grill & Bar reported experiencing chemical burns Wednesday after consuming margaritas that had been prepared with an industrial cleaning chemical that was mistaken for sugar or salt.

The Foothills Health District said the incident unfolded at a restaurant in Forest City, North Carolina.

Three customers consumed the contaminated margaritas, while two restaurant employees also reportedly experienced symptoms after exposure to the chemical, according to the health district.

ROACHES CAUGHT CRAWLING ACROSS POPULAR STEAKHOUSE'S KITCHEN FLOOR IN VIRAL EMPLOYEE VIDEO

According to preliminary findings, the mix-up began Monday when an employee received an industrial degreaser from a contracted worker and placed it in an unmarked container.

The container was then brought inside the restaurant and left in the bar area.

Two days later, an employee preparing the bar for lunch service discovered the unlabeled container and, believing its contents to be sugar or salt, used the chemical to prepare the margarita station, the health district said.

Shortly after the restaurant opened, three customers consumed the contaminated beverages and "immediately experienced discomfort and chemical burns in and around their mouths."

After the customers alerted staff, two employees also tasted the substance and reported similar symptoms.

CHILI'S REVIVES ICONIC RED BOOTHS AND CLASSIC DESIGN IN NATIONWIDE RESTAURANT OVERHAUL

In a statement to Fox News Digital, Chili's said the company took immediate action to support those affected.

"We are aware of an isolated incident at our restaurant in Forest City, North Carolina that resulted in injuries to two of our guests and Team Members. Our team took immediate action to support those affected and avoid any further injuries. We are actively investigating the circumstances related to this incident as the health and wellbeing of our guests and Team Members remain our top priority," the company said.

The company’s account differed from the Foothills Health District’s preliminary findings, which said three customers experienced chemical burns after consuming the margaritas.

After the Foothills Health District launched an investigation, the restaurant's food service permit was immediately suspended.

It was quickly reinstated on Thursday after specialists determined the restaurant met all other food safety standards.

MORE THAN 12,000 POUNDS OF BACON RECALLED AFTER USDA ISSUES HIGHEST-RISK ALERT

The health district used the incident to remind all food service establishments in North Carolina that chemicals must be properly labeled and stored away from food-handling areas.

"This incident highlights the importance of proper chemical labeling, storage, and handling in food service establishments, as required by the North Carolina Food Code, to prevent chemical contamination and protect public health," Jason Masters, the health director of Foothills Health District, said in a statement.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/us/chilis-customers-suffer-chemical-burns-after-dangerous-margarita-mix-up

posts.title: ‘X-Men,’ ‘Star Trek’ Star Patrick Stewart Dies At 86
posts.excerpt: His best known Hollywood roles were as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in "Star Trek: The Next Generation" and Professor Charles Xavier in multiple "X-Men" and related Marvel films. The post ‘X-Men,’ ‘Star Tr
posts.content:
Patrick Stewart, the British Shakespearean actor who became a Hollywood megastar through roles in the “Star Trek” and “X-Men” franchises, has died at the age of 86, an official statement said Thursday.

“We announce with great sorrow the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart yesterday at his home in Los Angeles, in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny, following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia,” the statement said.

The actor, who hailed from the northern English region of Yorkshire, trod the boards in Britain with the Royal Shakespeare Company before crossing the Atlantic to enjoy an acclaimed career on the US stage and screen.

His best known Hollywood roles were as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in “Star Trek: The Next Generation” and Professor Charles Xavier in multiple “X-Men” and related Marvel films.

British actor Sir Patrick Stewart arrives to Paramount+ Star Trek Day held at Skirball Cultural Center in Los Angeles, California, on September 8, 2022. Photo by MICHAEL TRAN / AFP

“His sonorous voice and singular talent will forever be synonymous with indelible performances in every genre,” the statement said.

“He explored the human condition in all its poetic complexity and brought hope not only to the far reaches of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, but into science fiction’s most iconic final frontier aboard the Starship Enterprise.”

AFP

posts.title: Iran has no plans for talks with US — Foreign minister
posts.excerpt: Iran's top diplomat on Saturday said there were no plans to hold talks with the United States despite growing concerns over a return to war. The post Iran has no plans for talks with US — Foreign mini
posts.content:
Iran’s top diplomat on Saturday said there were no plans to hold talks with the United States despite growing concerns over a return to war.

“Currently, there are no plans for meetings with American officials, and any speculation to the contrary is merely media assumption,” Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said in an interview with Al Jazeera, according to the state news agency IRNA.

“Under current circumstances, Iran sees no necessity for a meeting with the Americans; Iran’s conditions are clear, and consultations regarding them are ongoing among mediators,” he said.

Araghchi confirmed that Iran received a letter from US Vice President JD Vance, following days of diplomatic efforts to head off a return to violence.

“The message from American Vice President JD Vance has been carefully reviewed and discussed in high-level meetings,” he said.

“If Washington’s objective in sending the message is to sow discord, this would be yet another misstep, adding to America’s previous errors.”

But Araghchi added: “The American side’s effort to open a dialogue and reach a broader understanding is viewed as a positive step.”

AFP

posts.title: France deploys 70,000 police officers to prepare for new wave of protests on Halloween
posts.excerpt: Emmanuel Macron's government deploys 70,000 police officers as France braces for a third week of intense protests amid over $1 billion in losses.
posts.content:
The French government is deploying 70,000 police officers to cities across the country as authorities expect a third week of intense anti-government protests to resume Saturday.

Demonstrators objecting to rising costs and President Emmanuel Macron's government have engaged in looting and damaging property, prompting the law enforcement surge, according to officials.

"Everyone is on deck to ensure an extremely firm response to any trouble," Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said at a news conference early in the week.

FRANCE ON EDGE WITH 70,000 POLICE DEPLOYED FOR UNREST AS AUTHORITIES PROBE SUSPECTED TERROR ATTACK NEAR PARIS

The expected protests, coinciding with Halloween, introduce an additional element to authorities' response, as some protesters are expected to don Halloween masks to hide their identities.

At least 150 planned gatherings across the country have been tracked and acknowledged by the Interior Ministry.

FRANCE'S MACRON BLAMES PROTESTS ON 'ULTRA-LEFT GROUPS WHOSE AIM IS TO BRING DOWN THE REPUBLIC'

One of the events, a planned march between the iconic Parisian squares of Republique and Bastille, has been banned by France's top administrative court. The demonstration was instead rerouted to boulevards on the eastern fringe of the city, far from the main shopping centers.

France's Chamber of Commerce has estimated retail losses from looting and property damage at over $1 billion, while other estimates that include lost revenue calculate losses could be double that.

PHOTOS SHOW AFTERMATH OF RIOTS AS MASKED GROUPS CLASH WITH POLICE ACROSS FRANCE

Some of Paris' iconic luxury shops, like Hermes and Louis Vuitton, have been targeted by rioters as France's marquee shopping avenues now show scores of buildings with protective wooden boards.

In response to the unrest, France's government is crafting a law that would punish rioters who caused property damage and make them liable to pay up to €10,000, or $11,000.

VIOLENCE ERUPTS AT FRANCE PROTESTS AS MACRON WARNS UNREST IS BEING EXPLOITED

Demonstrations originated with the country's young people protesting schooling conditions and pushing for educational reform and quickly ballooned to include other social groups and issues, including economic anxieties, rising costs in fuel and borrowing.

Though the French government has vowed to reform education and reduce fuel costs, the promises have not satisfied the protesters.

"When I was little, I was told young people were the future," 15-year-old high school student Aaron Berthier de Grandry, who plans on protesting over the weekend, told Reuters.

"Well, if we, as the future of France, lack resources, that means France will end up collapsing," de Grandry added.

The U.S. Embassy in France has advised travelers to avoid areas where large gatherings are taking place.

Reuters contributed to this report.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/world/france-deploys-70000-police-officers-prepare-new-wave-protests-halloween

posts.title: 2027: ‘Three factors that’ll swing votes for Tinubu’
posts.excerpt: "That is what makes a leader, because he first prayed for the country, prayed for every Nigerian and also he said God has already selected the winner in this election" The post 2027: ‘Three factors th
posts.content:
By Omeiza Ajayi, ABUJA

The Director General of the ruling All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council APC-PCC, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, has named President Bola Tinubu’s faith in God, his record of performance and the campaign organisation’s capacity to win the hearts of the electorate as the three factors that will swing votes for him in January’s presidential election.

Read Also: ‘Northern leaders begged Tinubu to support Buhari, promised to return power after eight years’ – APC chieftain

Yari, a former Governor of Zamfara State, spoke with journalists at the weekend in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, where he joined the President and other eminent Nigerians to perform Umrah, the muslim lesser pilgrimage. The footage of the interview was obtained on Saturday in Abuja.

He said the three factors would ultimately secure victory for Tinubu, and reaffirmed the APC-PCC’s commitment to securing the buy-in of Nigerians for the President’s second-term bid.

His remarks followed a media chat in Saudi Arabia on Friday, at which Tinubu expressed what he called enormous faith in God to be re-elected.

“I believe that Allah’s wish in His court must prevail. And there’s no other God but Allah. Allah is the only one who can define a human being, what he will be, and what he will become”, he said.

Yari said the President’s response was the mark of a true leader.

“That is what makes a leader, because when you ask him, he first prayed for the country, prayed for every Nigerian and also he says this election is an election that God has selected the person who will be a leader, and only Him that can put a leader or otherwise,” he said.

The APC-PCC boss added that the campaign would match that faith with work on the ground.

“So in total, I depend on Allah to do it for him as he did it for him in 2023. By that, Allah says we should work, that all the procedures we are undertaking, to campaign, to talk to people, to convince them, to show them what we have done, what we have achieved and that by His grace, people will be convinced to elect us,” he said.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027-three-factors-thatll-swing-votes-for-tinubu/

posts.title: ‘High school abroad can be treacherous’ — Morayo Brown warns parents after killing of Ghanaian teen
posts.excerpt: TV host Morayo Brown has warned parents against sending emotionally immature teenagers abroad for high school, following reports that a 15-year-old Ghanaian boy was killed in the United States after a
posts.content:
TV host Morayo Brown has warned parents against sending emotionally immature teenagers abroad for high school, following reports that a 15-year-old Ghanaian boy was killed in the United States after allegedly being bullied.

Brown gave the warning while reacting to the incident, recalling how she was bullied when she attended high school in the US at the age of 15.

She said fellow students targeted her because she was African, put dirty items in her locker and pushed her during morning sports activities.

Brown said she did not report the incidents because she was new to the school and wanted to fit in, adding that some students repeatedly made her feel she did not belong.

She also recalled that the bullying worsened when she was preparing to attend prom.

The TV host said parents should ensure their children are emotionally mature and properly guided before sending them abroad for secondary education.

“University abroad is fine, but high school can be treacherous,” she said.

She urged parents to communicate regularly with their children, ask questions about their experiences and provide the support they need while adjusting to life in a foreign country.

posts.title: ADC-PCC gives Sokoto authorities 24-hr ultimatum over attack on guber candidate
posts.excerpt: The African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council (ADC-PCC) has given security authorities in Sokoto State 24 hours to arrest those behind an attack on its governorship candidate, Alhaji M
posts.content:
By Luminous Jannamike

The African Democratic Congress Presidential Campaign Council (ADC-PCC) has given security authorities in Sokoto State 24 hours to arrest those behind an attack on its governorship candidate, Alhaji Munir Dan Iya.

The ultimatum followed the alleged attack by operatives of the state-owned Sokoto Marshals, the vandalisation of several vehicles in the candidate’s convoy and the reported abduction of two Department of State Services (DSS) personnel attached to him.

In a statement by its Director of Media and Publicity, Kola Ologbondiyan, the ADC-PCC said the attack occurred along Airport Road, Sokoto, on Friday night, as Dan Iya returned to the city after accompanying former governor and Senator representing Sokoto South, Aminu Waziri Tambuwal, from the airport.

Ologbondiyan said the candidate’s personal SUV was among the vehicles vandalised, adding that Dan Iya had personally reported the incident to the Sokoto State Commissioner of Police.

But the council said the attack was only part of a wider campaign of intimidation, alleging that operatives of the Sokoto Marshals had taken positions at various historic gates into the metropolis, harassing motorists and targeting vehicles displaying ADC posters, insignia and other party symbols.

It said the reported abduction of two DSS personnel attached to the candidate had further heightened concerns over the incident.

“This is not governance. It is banditry in uniform, and it must not be tolerated in a democracy,” Ologbondiyan declared.

The ADC-PCC described the incident as part of what it called a growing pattern of political violence against opposition figures, recalling similar attacks reportedly recorded in Kaduna and other states in recent weeks.

It warned that the party would no longer stand by while its candidates, leaders and members were subjected to intimidation and violence, insisting that it was prepared to defend their constitutional rights through every legitimate means.

The council called on the Inspector-General of Police, the Sokoto Commissioner of Police and relevant security and intelligence agencies to immediately investigate the attack, arrest those responsible and secure the release of the two DSS personnel.

It gave the authorities 24 hours to rein in the operatives, guarantee the safety of its candidate and members, and commence decisive action against those implicated.

“Failure to do so will leave the leadership of our party with no option but to take further decisive and lawful steps to protect its members, defend its political rights and safeguard our democracy,” the statement warned.

The ADC-PCC cautioned that the alleged deployment of a taxpayer-funded security outfit against political opponents could push the country towards an era of state-backed political intimidation, insisting that it would resist any attempt to silence the opposition through violence.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/adc-pcc-gives-sokoto-authorities-24-hr-ultimatum-over-attack-on-guber-candidate/

posts.content:
Many persons have reportedly died following a collision between two trucks by the Ovia River along the Lagos-Benin Expressway in Edo State.

One of the trucks was laden with crates of drinks, while the other carried glasses.

It was learnt that the trucks were driving in opposite directions at very high speed when the head-on collision occurred.

The drivers, their motor boys and other persons doing business along the road died immediately after the accident.

The incident has caused a serious gridlock along the road as passengers are currently stranded and trapped along the road.

Passengers who spoke with DAILY POST expressed sadness over the deplorable state of the road, saying it added to the increased cost of transportation and caused delays to their movements as well as killing their businesses.

A driver simply identified as Emmanuel said that after every journey, he visits the mechanic workshop and spends a lot of money to fix his vehicle before entering the road again.

He claimed that the state of the road was affecting him and his business.

Olaoluwa, a passenger travelling from Lagos to Warri, Delta State, said he has been trapped in the gridlock for three days running.

"Instead of the politicians helping the citizens by constructing the road and providing them with the basic amenities, including security, they are busy campaigning and toiling with Nigerians, he lamented.

Other passengers who also bared their minds on the state of the road urged President Bola Tinubu to help Nigerians, especially drivers and passengers, put the road in a good shape.

posts.title: FUOYE threatens to sue publishers over cybercrime allegations against VC
posts.excerpt: The Federal University, Oye-Ekiti, FUOYE, has threatened legal action against media organisations and publishers over reports linking its Vice-Chancellor, Professor Joshua Ogunwole, and other principa
posts.content:
The Federal University, Oye-Ekiti, FUOYE, has threatened legal action against media organisations and publishers over reports linking its Vice-Chancellor, Professor Joshua Ogunwole, and other principal officers to alleged cybercrime offences.

The university expressed concerns over what it described as repeated attempts to tarnish the image of the Vice-Chancellor and the institution through publications which allegedly presented unsubstantiated claims as established facts.

The university spoke in a statement signed and made available to journalists by the registrar, Mufutau Ibrahim.

The statement disclosed that the university's lawyers were reviewing the publications and would formally contact the publishers to demand explanations and credible evidence supporting their reports.

The institution warned that failure to provide satisfactory explanations or verifiable evidence could compel it to institute legal proceedings against the publishers, including civil action and where permitted by law, criminal proceedings.

The university maintained that Professor Ogunwole had not been found guilty by any court of unlawfully intercepting private conversations, accessing electronic information or tampering with communication devices.

FUOYE also denied allegations that the vice-chancellor hacked anyone's telephone, intercepted private communications or manipulated electronic information belonging to another person.

Parts of the statement read: "The Federal University Oye-Ekiti, FUOYE, is considering legal action against publishers of reports linking its Vice-Chancellor, Professor Joshua Olalekan Ogunwole, and other principal officers to alleged cybercrime offences.

"The university was worried about the continued publication of allegations which, in its view, were giving the public a wrong impression about the Vice-Chancellor and the leadership of the institution.

"If the publishers failed to provide satisfactory explanations or credible evidence, the university would consider taking them to court.

"Professor Ogunwole had not been found guilty by any court of unlawfully intercepting private conversations, accessing electronic information or tampering with communication devices.

"The Vice-Chancellor did not hack any telephone, intercept private communications or alter electronic information belonging to anyone.

"The matter involved an audio recording that was already circulating publicly before it came to the attention of the university management.

"Neither the university nor the Vice-Chancellor was responsible for making the recording or bringing it into circulation.

"The recording later became an issue within the university, leading to an administrative process in which some individuals connected with the matter were asked to provide explanations.

"Professor Ogunwole only became involved because of his responsibilities as Vice-Chancellor, as there was nothing in its records to suggest that he unlawfully obtained, recorded or altered anyone's private conversation."

FUOYE threatens to sue publishers over cybercrime allegations against VC

posts.content:
The Kaduna State University(KASU) branch of the Academic Staff Union of Universities(ASUU), has commended Governor Uba Sani for fully implementing the 2025 Federal Government-ASUU Agreement.

In a press briefing on Friday, the union noted that the implementation of the agreement and the commitment to the welfare of academic staff, will enhance morale, improved productivity and strengthen industrial relations.

The briefing which was delivered by Comrade Abubakar Abdullahi and Comrade Silas Amos Bakut, Chairman and Secretary respectively, also recalled other welfare initiatives that Governor Uba Sani had earlier extended to their members.

According to the duo, the latest intervention represents a significant milestone in the development of the university and it is expected to contribute to the overall advancement of the institution.

‘’We consider this development a positive demonstration of the State Government's recognition of the vital role of academic staff in advancing quality university education and sustainable development,’’ ASUU noted.

The union commended Kaduna State Government and the Management of KASU for their commendable and exemplary handling of the earlier industrial action.

‘’For the avoidance of doubt, we wish to state categorically that, at no point during the strike action, were the union or its members subjected to intimidation, threats or any form of harassment.

‘’Remarkably, our salaries were paid while the strike was still ongoing, and engagements between the union, the Government and University Management remained cordial, constructive and focused on addressing the fundamental issues in dispute.

‘’This approach represents a significant departure from some of the unfortunate experiences of the past and demonstrates a renewed commitment to mutual respect, dialogue and the peaceful resolution of industrial disputes,’’ ASUU disclosed.

The union also noted that the Governor Uba Sani administration has made positive progress in addressing ‘’several inherited welfare challenges affecting our members.’’

‘’Specifically, the Government has addressed the 60 percent withheld salary of 2017, paid outstanding Students Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES) allowances for the period 2016-2020 and settled five months of withheld salaries covering May to September 2022,’’ the union disclosed.

According to them, the Governor has also ‘’advanced the sum of N300 million towards the settlement of Earned Academic Allowance (EAA) arrears for the 2016-2020 academic sessions.’’

‘’Furthermore, the Governing Council and Management of Kaduna State University are working collaboratively with the union towards resolving outstanding death benefits and promotion arrears dating from 2021,’’ ASUU added.

While commending the Governor and the varsity management for demonstrating the leadership, courage and the political will required to address these longstanding challenges, the union noted that the interventions have brought considerable relief to affected members.

The ASUU executives also listed other initiatives that the Kaduna State Government, under Governor Uba Sani, have extended to them in the last three and half years, to enhance staff welfare.

The union recalled that the Governor approved about 10.2 hectres of land ‘’for the KASU-ASUU Multipurpose Cooperative Society to develop the Academia Housing Estate, a mass housing project designed to benefit our members and other civil servants.’’

‘’Beyond the land allocation, His Excellency graciously approved a subsidy of 4,000,000,00 for each beneficiary, amounting to approximately 400,000,000.00 for the project.

‘’This intervention has reduced the cost of a housing unit from 40,000,000.00 to 136,000,000.00, thereby making homeownership more accessible to the beneficiaries,’’ ASUU pointed out.

The union expressed appreciation for the genuine commitment in prioritising dialogue over confrontation and seeking sustainable solutions to their concerns, exhibited by Government and KASU Management.

‘’We reiterate our commitment to constructive engagement with the State Government, the Governing Council and University Management towards resolving all outstanding welfare issues, strengthening industrial harmony and positioning Kaduna State University among the leading universities in Nigeria and globally, ‘’ they promised.

ASUU also commended the invaluable contributions, leadership and commitment of the Commissioner of Education and Chairman of the Negotiation Committee, Emeritus Professor Abubakar Sani Sambo.

The union also praised the ‘’Chairman of the Governing Council, Dr. Ibrahim Umar; the Chairman of the Sub-Committee, Professor Usman Abubakar; and all other members of the Negotiation Committee for their dedication and concerted efforts towards resolving the issues in dispute.’’

posts.title: Atiku’s son: ‘My support for Tinubu is personal’; pledges 10 buses
posts.excerpt: "I wish to make one fundamental point: political conviction is a matter of personal judgement, conscience and the freedom of every individual to make independent choices" The post Atiku’s son: ‘My sup
posts.content:
By Omeiza Ajayi, ABUJA

The son of former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, Abba, has said his decision to back President Bola Tinubu’s re-election is a personal choice made in conscience, which he acknowledged may be viewed against the political positions of people he shares family relationships with.

Read Also: ‘Northern leaders begged Tinubu to support Buhari, promised to return power after eight years’ – APC chieftain

Abubakar, Founder and Chairman of the Haske Bola Tinubu Organisation, HBTO, made the declaration at the group’s press conference in Abuja.

He said political decisions that differ from the positions of relatives “often attract considerable public attention” and that he was “equally conscious that my own political decision may be viewed within this context.”

“However, I wish to make one fundamental point: political conviction is a matter of personal judgement, conscience and the freedom of every individual to make independent choices,” he said.

He described the formation of HBTO as “a deliberate political choice, one I have made in my personal capacity and with a firm belief in the direction we have chosen to pursue.

“I hold no reservations about the right of others to their differing political opinions, just as I expect my own convictions to be respected,” he added.

Abba Abubakar said HBTO is a political mobilisation and support platform established to bring together Nigerians who share a common conviction in the leadership and reform agenda of the president and the All Progressives Congress, APC-led administration.

On Tinubu’s reforms

He admitted that the president’s reforms “have come with difficult adjustments for Nigerians,” but said it was “equally important to recognise the progress, opportunities and long-term benefits that several of these initiatives are designed to deliver.”

Citing examples, Abba pointed to the Nigerian Education Loan Fund, NELFUND, which he said “has opened new opportunities for students to access interest-free educational loans, helping to ease the financial burden on families and improve access to higher education.”

He also credited the administration’s investments in roads and other transport networks for “improving connectivity, facilitating the movement of goods and services, and strengthening economic activities across the country.”

On state finances, Abba Abubakar noted the increased revenue allocations to state governments through the Federation Account Allocation Committee FAAC, which he said have given states “greater fiscal capacity to meet their obligations, including the payment of salaries, pensions and other outstanding commitments.”

He added that public sector workers have benefited from “interventions aimed at cushioning the effects of prevailing economic realities, including the recent N70,000 transportation support.”

The HBTO chairman announced that the group would begin a transportation support programme with “the initial provision of 10 luxury buses,” starting in the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, Abuja, before expanding to other parts of the country.

“For us, supporting the President’s Renewed Hope Agenda must translate into meaningful actions that positively affect the everyday lives of Nigerians,” he said.

Abubakar also disclosed plans for what he called a “two-million-man mobilisation march across Nigeria’s six geopolitical zones,” to begin in Abuja.

‘We are working with Wike’

He said the group’s immediate focus would be “supporting the FCT Minister, whom we recognise as a key political leader in our mobilisation structure, in the collective effort to secure victory for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu in the Federal Capital Territory in 2027.”

According to him, HBTO is working in alignment with the FCT Minister’s objective of delivering both the FCT and Rivers State for the president in the forthcoming election.

“Our organisation is preparing for a major political mobilisation exercise in Rivers State next week,” he said. “I can assure you that our structures are being activated, our members are on ground, and our supporters are ready to demonstrate the strength and reach of this movement.”

He said the effort was not about “numbers or political appearances,” but about “building a disciplined, coordinated and effective grassroots mobilisation network capable of translating political support into electoral results.”

Abba Abubakar said HBTO would establish a presence across the geopolitical zones and work with “political stakeholders, community leaders, youth organisations, women groups and other well-meaning Nigerians.”

“We are confident in our direction, committed to our objectives and determined to contribute our quota to the success of the President’s reform agenda and his re-election bid in 2027,” he said.

Vanguard News

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/atikus-son-my-support-for-tinubu-is-personal-pledges-10-buses/

posts.title: Peter Obi Joins Seriake Dickson For Bayelsa Homecoming, Boat Regatta
posts.excerpt: Obi addressed the maritime and commercial viability of the Niger Delta. Decrying the systemic underutilisation of coastal economic corridors, he committed to a decentralised port expansion strategy. T
posts.content:
Presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, travelled to Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, to attend the grand homecoming ceremony honouring Senator Henry Seriake Dickson, the National Leader of their party.

The visit drew large crowds of supporters and provided a platform for Obi to outline alternative governance strategies, sharply contrasting current federal administrative practices with his own policy platform.

Addressing stakeholders in the riverine state, Obi directed criticism toward President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s domestic presence and foreign travel record.

“After more than three years in office, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has not considered it appropriate to spend even one night in Bayelsa State, despite spending over 260 days abroad,” Obi stated.

Offering a direct commitment to regional engagement, he added:

“I assured our numerous supporters and the people of Bayelsa State that this will not happen under my leadership. I will visit Bayelsa to hear directly from our people and respond to their concerns.”

Peter Obi and Senator Henry Seriake Dickson taking part in a traditional boat regatta in Toru-Orua, Bayelsa State. (Photo credit: https://x.com/PeterObi)

Pledging Regional Port Decentralisation

Shifting focus to economic development, Obi addressed the maritime and commercial viability of the Niger Delta. Decrying the systemic underutilisation of coastal economic corridors, he committed to a decentralised port expansion strategy.

“In Bayelsa, I pledged that we would begin efforts to upgrade ports throughout the Niger Delta, including those in Warri, Port Harcourt, and Calabar,” Obi announced.

He further pledged to accelerate stalled regional projects:

“We will also begin construction of the long-delayed Ibaka seaport in Akwa Ibom State and establish a new port in Bayelsa State to serve our riverine communities and the broader Niger Delta more effectively.”

Obi reaffirmed his broader national policy framework, emphasising that national security, anti-corruption enforcement, and heavy capital investments in human capital—specifically healthcare and education—remain prerequisites for pulling citizens out of poverty.

The political engagement concluded with traditional festivities as Obi joined Senator Henry Seriake Dickson in his hometown of Toru-Orua, situated within the Sagbama Local Government Area.

Peter Obi acknowledges a crowd of cheering supporters from a vehicle sunroof during his visit to Bayelsa State. (Photo credit: https://x.com/PeterObi)

The political delegation partook in local cultural displays, capping the visit by attending a traditional canoe war game and boat regatta along the community waterways.

Obi commended local and national party leadership for the coordination of the event, offering closing congratulations to his host:

“I congratulate my dear brother, Senator Henry Seriake Dickson, on his successful return home. I appreciate our party’s national and state leadership, members as well as the good people of Bayelsa for good organisation, warm reception and successful event.”

Source: https://www.channelstv.com/2026/10/31/peter-obi-joins-seriake-dickson-for-bayelsa-homecoming-boat-regatta/

Harry Styles has recreated his original X Factor audition, performing Stevie Wonder‘s ‘Isn’t She Lovely’ while dressed as his 16-year-old self – watch footage below.

The singer was performing the first of two ‘Harryween’ concerts at Madison Square Garden last night (October 30), marking the penultimate date of his mammoth 30-night residency at the venue.

For the occasion, Styles initially appeared dressed as Elvis Presley, wearing the King’s signature white jumpsuit, complete with a cape and gold sunglasses. His backing band and dancers also embraced the Halloween theme, dressing as various versions of Styles from throughout his career, including looks inspired by his appearances at Coachella, the Grammys and the Met Gala.

Later in the show, however, Styles changed into an altogether different costume, recreating the clothes he wore for his original audition on The X Factor in 2010.

He went on to perform ‘Isn’t She Lovely’, the Stevie Wonder classic that helped launch his career when he sang it for judges Simon Cowell, Nicole Scherzinger and Louis Walsh at the age of 16. Styles also jokingly recreated one of his memorable comments from the audition, telling the Madison Square Garden audience: “I work in a bakery.”

Watch footage of the performance below:

Full version of Harry singing Isn’t She Lovely as his 16 year old self on stage at Madison Square Garden in New York City – October 30 (via @idkallyne) pic.twitter.com/zPJfd31h3C

— HSD Together On Tour (@hsdtogethertour) October 31, 2026

The original audition saw Styles arrive as a teenager from Holmes Chapel, Cheshire, where he had been working part-time at a bakery.

Although viewers initially saw him perform Wonder’s 1976 hit a cappella, extended footage released by The X Factor in 2022 revealed that he had first attempted Train’s ‘Hey, Soul Sister’.

Cowell interrupted that performance and asked: “I don’t know whether it’s the track that’s throwing you, but can I hear something just you, without any music?”

Styles then sang ‘Isn’t She Lovely’, advancing to the next stage of the competition before eventually being brought together with Niall Horan, Zayn Malik, Liam Payne and Louis Tomlinson to form One Direction.

Revisit the original audition below:

The costume changes were part of Styles’ revived ‘Harryween’ tradition, which first saw him hold two special Halloween concerts at Madison Square Garden in 2021.

On the opening night that year, he dressed as Dorothy from The Wizard Of Oz and performed ‘Somewhere Over The Rainbow’, with his band dressed as other characters from the 1939 film.

The following evening, he wore an elaborate clown costume and covered Britney Spears‘ ‘Toxic’.

Styles continued the tradition in Los Angeles in 2022, when he dressed as Danny Zuko from Grease and covered Olivia Newton-John‘s ‘Hopelessly Devoted To You’.

The latest concert comes towards the end of Styles’ 30-night Madison Square Garden residency, which began in August as part of his ongoing ‘Together, Together’ world tour.

Earlier this week, he performed ‘Ever Since New York’ for the first time in four years, while the residency has also seen him pay tribute to his late One Direction bandmate Liam Payne with the new song ‘What Is Enough’.

The New York run concludes tonight (October 31) with a second ‘Harryween’ show, before Styles heads to Australia for concerts in Melbourne and Sydney in November and December.

The tour comes in support of his fourth solo album ‘Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally’, which was released in March and received a four-star review from NME.

Reviewing the ‘Together, Together’ tour in Amsterdam in May, NME awarded the performance five stars, praising its sense of community and describing it as “a hopeful celebration of community and connection”.

Styles has also announced further tour dates for 2027, including additional Wembley Stadium concerts and support from Kylie Minogue, LCD Soundsystem and more.

posts.title: Cool FM Announces COMA, the Cool FM Music Awards, Recognising the Sounds and Creatives Shaping Nigerian Music
posts.excerpt: For nearly three decades, Cool FM has been at the heart of Nigeria’s music and entertainment landscape - connecting audiences to the sounds, artists and cultural movements that define generations. Tod
posts.content:
For nearly three decades, Cool FM has been at the heart of Nigeria’s music and entertainment landscape - connecting audiences to the sounds, artists and cultural movements that define generations.

Today, Cool FM takes that legacy a step further with the launch of COMA, the Cool FM Music Awards, a new recognition platform celebrating the talent, creativity and cultural influence driving Nigeria’s music industry.

COMA is built on a simple belief: great music is never created in isolation.

Behind every hit, every breakthrough artist and every defining cultural moment is an ecosystem of producers, DJs, directors, photographers, designers, content creators and passionate fans who help bring Nigerian music to life.

COMA sets out to recognise that entire ecosystem.

Featuring 17 award categories and the prestigious Cool FM Icon Award, the initiative celebrates achievement across four key pillars: Music, Creative & Visuals, Fashion & Style, and Culture & Influence.

A STATEMENT FROM COOL FM

Speaking on the launch, Serge Noujaim, Chief Executive Officer of Cool FM, said:

“Cool FM has spent nearly three decades shaping Nigeria’s music culture. With COMA, we are taking that legacy further - celebrating not just the stars, but the entire creative ecosystem behind their success. Nigerian music has conquered the world. It is time we honour the people making it happen.”

Joseph Adamu, Project Chairman of COMA, added:

“COMA is about recognising real talent, creativity and cultural impact. Our ambition is to build a credible awards platform where industry expertise, measurable performance and the voice of the audience come together to celebrate excellence.”

RECOGNITION BUILT ON MERIT AND CULTURAL IMPACT

COMA introduces a structured selection process combining measurable industry performance with professional evaluation and audience participation.

There are no entry forms or submission fees. Nominees are identified through streaming performance, radio airplay, DJ rotation, social engagement and editorial assessment, covering eligible work released between 1 December 2025 and 31 October 2026.

A judging panel of industry figures will determine the final nominees, while winners will be selected through a weighted combination of judging, public digital voting and Cool FM on-air audience participation. Category-specific weightings will be published before voting opens.

The judging panel will be announced on 31 October, followed by the unveiling of nominees and the opening of voting in November.

Winners will be announced digitally on 4 December 2026.

ABOUT COOL FM

Cool FM is one of Nigeria’s established contemporary music and entertainment radio brands, with nearly three decades of influence in the country’s evolving music landscape.

Through COMA, Cool FM reinforces its commitment to discovering talent, championing creativity and celebrating the people shaping Nigerian music and culture.

MEDIA CONTACT Communications & External Relations Adaeze Enuma - 0807 708 6026 coma@coolfm.ng | www.coolfm.ng

Source: https://notjustok.com/news/cool-fm-announces-coma-the-cool-fm-music-awards/

posts.title: “Blue dot fever”: Lily Allen dresses up as Ticketmaster unsold seat map for Halloween
posts.excerpt: The singer was poking fun at the ticket sales controversy surrounding her recent North American tour The post “Blue dot fever”: Lily Allen dresses up as Ticketmaster unsold seat map for Halloween appe
posts.content:
Lily Allen has poked fun at the ticket sales controversy surrounding her recent US tour by dressing up as a Ticketmaster seating map full of unsold tickets for Halloween.

READ MORE: Lily Allen live in London: a powerful retelling of one of pop’s most gut-wrenching albums

The singer shared photos of her outfit on Instagram yesterday (October 30), wearing a white puffer jacket and matching bodysuit covered in blue dots, alongside a black top marked “Stage”.

She also posed with a thermometer, referencing the term “blue dot fever”, which has been used throughout 2026 to describe artists struggling to sell tickets for their live shows.

The phrase refers to the blue dots on Ticketmaster’s interactive seating plans, which represent tickets that remain available for purchase. A proliferation of blue dots has become shorthand for disappointing ticket sales and overly ambitious venue bookings.

Allen captioned the photos: “Never beating the allegations. #bluedotfever”.

See her costume below:

Lily Allen dresses up as a Ticketmaster seat map for Halloween:

“Never beating the allegations #bluedotfever” pic.twitter.com/VHxBZtT9TR

— Pop Base (@PopBase) October 30, 2026

The joke follows the singer’s decision to downsize several venues on the North American leg of her ‘West End Girl’ tour earlier this year.

In July, she announced that concerts in Chicago, Los Angeles, San Francisco and other cities would be moved to smaller venues, while a planned show in Montreal was cancelled.

Among the changes was the relocation of her Chicago concert from the 23,500-capacity United Center to the 3,500-capacity Chicago Theatre. A planned show at San Francisco’s Chase Center was also moved to Oakland’s smaller Paramount Theatre.

Speaking about the decision in an interview last month, Allen acknowledged: “The ticket sales weren’t there.”

She explained that the original venue bookings had been driven by promoters’ expectations, and that she had expressed concerns about the scale of the tour from the outset.

“I said to my manager, ‘Are you sure? This seems like a stretch.’ And he was like, ‘This is what they’re telling me.’ So we accepted it,” she recalled.

Allen said she had been reluctant to cancel the concerts outright because she had a crew of around 50 people relying on the work.

She also criticised the lack of transparency in concert ticketing, recounting how fans had obtained cheap last-minute tickets for shows she had previously been told were sold out.

“I think the live industry is a minefield, and I don’t know how it works,” she said. “Someone knows, but it ain’t the artist.”

The tour has seen Allen perform her acclaimed 2025 album ‘West End Girl’ in its entirety, in a theatrical production featuring backing tracks rather than a live band, with minimal audience interaction.

She previously defended the unconventional format after facing criticism, explaining: “It’s my artistic choice not to talk to the audience, the fourth wall helps with the storytelling.”

“Everyone on this tour is really working very hard to give people the best show we possibly can, and I’m extremely proud of it.”

NME reviewed the tour at the London Palladium in March, awarding it three stars and describing the production as “a powerful retelling of one of pop’s most gut-wrenching albums”.

The album itself, inspired by the breakdown of Allen’s marriage to Stranger Things actor David Harbour, received a four-star review from NME, which hailed it as “a vicious, vulnerable and victorious comeback”.

Source: https://www.nme.com/news/music/blue-dot-fever-lily-allen-ticketmaster-unsold-seat-map-halloween-3974727?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=blue-dot-fever-lily-allen-ticketmaster-unsold-seat-map-halloween

posts.title: Greta Thunberg, Paloma Faith and Nemahsis join Macklemore at London ‘Free Palestine’ tour finale
posts.excerpt: The sold-out Wembley concert also featured speeches from Holocaust survivor Stephen Kapos and Palestinian activist Arab Barghouthi The post Greta Thunberg, Paloma Faith and Nemahsis join Macklemore at
posts.content:
Macklemore was joined by Greta Thunberg, Paloma Faith and Nemahsis as his sold-out ‘Free Palestine Tour’ concluded in London last night (October 30).

READ MORE: Nemahsis: “I always had to stand up for myself. It’s all I’ve ever known”

The concert at OVO Arena Wembley was the final date of the rapper’s three-show European benefit tour, which was organised after he was dropped from Ed Sheeran’s US ‘Loop Tour’ for making pro-Palestinian statements on stage.

Around 10,000 people attended the London show, which featured performances from several artists alongside speeches from activists and campaigners, with proceeds going to 12 organisations supporting Palestinians.

Thunberg opened the evening with a speech in which she praised the resilience of people in Gaza and urged attendees to continue campaigning beyond the concert.

She said that Palestinians had continued to celebrate their culture and support one another despite the devastation of the war, arguing that fundraising and solidarity also needed to be accompanied by political change.

Macklemore & Friends 『Free Palestine Tour』のロンドンのオープニングはGreta Thunberg。 pic.twitter.com/zdiIPWxT9X

— 前崎りつき (@ritsukimaesaki) October 30, 2026

Climate activist Greta Thunberg took to the stage at Wembley Arena to deliver a powerful message of solidarity with Gaza. pic.twitter.com/vP7ieKSQFf

— PALESTINE ONLINE (@OnlinePalEng) October 31, 2026

The Swedish activist warned that the “occupation will not end by philanthropy and slogans”, encouraging the audience to maintain their commitment to Palestinians after leaving the venue.

Thunberg had previously criticised Ed Sheeran’s response to Macklemore’s removal from his tour, accusing the singer of lacking the courage to stand up to pressure from concert promoters and venue owners.

Among the evening’s other performers was Palestinian-Canadian singer Nemahsis, who spoke about her experience of being dropped by her record label in 2023 after publicly expressing support for Palestine.

“My existence is the strongest form of resistance,” she told the Wembley crowd.

Macklemore & Friends 『Free Palestine Tour』at london pic.twitter.com/sAfOODDZaf

— 前崎りつき (@ritsukimaesaki) October 31, 2026

The singer, whose real name is Nemah Hasan, previously spoke to NME for The Cover about the difficulties she had faced in the music industry and her determination to continue speaking out.

Faith also performed at the concert, addressing the audience about the concerns she had felt over publicly supporting the Palestinian cause.

The singer, who said she was seven months postpartum, reflected on her responsibility as a mother and argued that the safety of children in Gaza, Sudan, Yemen and Congo was just as important as that of her own family.

Other speakers included Holocaust survivor Stephen Kapos, who recalled experiencing the Nazi occupation of Budapest as a child, and Antoine Raffoul, who was displaced from Palestine during the Nakba in 1948.

Arab Barghouthi, the son of imprisoned Palestinian political figure Marwan Barghouti, also addressed the audience, speaking about his father’s imprisonment and the importance of maintaining hope.

Macklemore & Friends 『Free Palestine Tour』のロンドンではたくさんゲストが登場。 中でも、Paloma FaithはMacklemoreを"私のヒーロー"と言うほど。彼女も変わらないスタンスでこのツアーに出てきた。 pic.twitter.com/KfR4mweC8V

— 前崎りつき (@ritsukimaesaki) October 31, 2026

Macklemore & Friends 『Free Palestine Tour』 子供達の歌も素晴らしかった。音楽でこうした動きをしているからこそ、音楽で繋がっているみたいで。 pic.twitter.com/Ufy5w75yoz

— 前崎りつき (@ritsukimaesaki) October 30, 2026

Macklemore subsequently took to the stage for a headline set featuring songs including ‘Thrift Shop’, ‘Same Love’, ‘These Days’, ‘Glorious’ and ‘Can’t Hold Us’, alongside his pro-Palestine protest track ‘Hind’s Hall’.

He also referred to an unsuccessful attempt by 50 members of the House of Lords to prevent him from entering the UK.

The peers had urged Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood to block his visit over concerns about the Palestinian Youth Movement, one of the organisations benefiting from the tour. The group has denied allegations that it celebrates terrorism or has links to terrorist organisations.

Reflecting on his decision to speak publicly about Gaza, Macklemore told the crowd that he had reached a point where remaining silent had become more uncomfortable than speaking out.

He insisted: “I don’t believe that saying something is courageous. I believe that saying something is human.”

Macklemore on point tonight at his concert for Palestine at Wembley Arena.

"I don't believe that saying something is brave. I don't believe that saying something is courageous. I believe that saying something is HUMAN. And those children in Gaza, are OUR children!"

pic.twitter.com/9OvxRRrKF8

— Ihtesham Malik Afzal (@Ihtesham_Afzal) October 31, 2026

The London concert followed the opening night in Dublin on Monday (October 26), where Macklemore was joined by Hozier, Kneecap, Beoga and more.

The tour then visited Paris on Thursday (October 29), with Aurora, Pomme and Portugal. The Man among those performing.

Following his removal from Sheeran’s tour, Macklemore pledged his entire $1million earnings to six organisations supporting Palestinians.

All proceeds from the three ‘Free Palestine’ benefit shows will also support organisations including Medical Aid for Palestinians, the Palestine Children’s Relief Fund, Gaza Soup Kitchen, HEAL Palestine, Jewish Voice for Peace and UNRWA USA.

Source: https://www.nme.com/news/music/greta-thunberg-paloma-faith-and-nemahsis-join-macklemore-at-london-free-palestine-tour-finale-3974723?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=greta-thunberg-paloma-faith-and-nemahsis-join-macklemore-at-london-free-palestine-tour-finale

posts.title: My Chemical Romance’s Gerard Way reveals plans to make new album in 2027 and return to touring in 2028
posts.excerpt: The band also reunited with The Used's Bert McCracken onstage for the first time since 2005 and debuted a rare ‘Danger Days’ track The post My Chemical Romance’s Gerard Way reveals plans to make new a
posts.content:
My Chemical Romance frontman Gerard Way has revealed that the band want to record a new album in 2027, and hinted that they hope to return to the stage in 2028.

READ MORE: My Chemical Romance live in Liverpool: prodigal sons of emo make tragedy transcendental

Way made the comments during the band’s ‘Devil’s Night’ concert at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles last night (October 30), the first of two special Halloween weekend performances at the venue.

Addressing the audience about the band’s future plans, he said: “So yeah, next year, we wanna go make a record,” prompting screams and cheers from the crowd.

“Hopefully we’ll see you guys in 2028,” he added, suggesting that the band could take next year away from touring to focus on recording their long-awaited fifth studio album.

Watch the moment below:

MY CHEMICAL ROMANCE JUST ANNOUNCED THAT NEXT YEAR THEY WANT TO MAKE ANOTHER RECORD!!

MCR5 IS REAL, IS HAPPENING pic.twitter.com/jBUXk6idtj

— AR* (@Arod_a_) October 31, 2026

The comments follow Way’s remarks at the closing night of the North American leg of their ‘Long Live The Black Parade’ tour in San Antonio last month.

On that occasion, he told fans: “Just know that, like, we’ve kind of really always wanted to make another record, so we hope that life allows us to do that.”

“Because you guys, honestly, you guys kept us alive so long. You guys deserve another record. I don’t know when it’ll be. But it’ll be awesome.”

A new album would be their first since 2010’s ‘Danger Days: The True Lives Of The Fabulous Killjoys’. The group split in 2013 before reuniting in 2019, and have released just one new song since their comeback, ‘The Foundations Of Decay’, in 2022.

During his previous comments in San Antonio, Way reflected on the death of longtime collaborator and producer Doug McKean, who worked on ‘The Foundations Of Decay’ before passing away later that year.

Way explained that the band had been excited about making more music following the song’s release, but that McKean’s death and other circumstances had disrupted their plans.

Elsewhere at Friday’s Hollywood Bowl concert, MCR reunited with The Used frontman Bert McCracken onstage for the first time since 2005.

The two singers were close friends during the early years of their careers, but their relationship deteriorated during the mid-2000s, around the time Way was pursuing sobriety.

During The Used’s opening set, McCracken told the audience that “mom and dad are back together again”, before Way joined him for a performance of ‘Buried Myself Alive’. McCracken subsequently returned during MCR’s headline set for ‘You Know What They Do To Guys Like Us In Prison’, from the band’s 2004 album ‘Three Cheers For Sweet Revenge’. Watch here:

Friday’s concert also saw My Chemical Romance perform ‘We Don’t Need Another Song About California’ live for the first time. Originally released as an iTunes-exclusive bonus track on ‘Danger Days’ in 2010, the song was made more widely available earlier this year as part of an expanded 15th anniversary edition of the album.

The performance came on the same day that MCR scored their first UK Number One album with ‘The Black Parade’, 20 years after its original release.

The landmark 2006 record, which initially peaked at Number Two in the UK, reached the top spot following the release of an expanded 20th anniversary reissue last Friday (October 23).

The Hollywood Bowl residency has seen MCR become the first group to play five consecutive nights at the historic Los Angeles venue.

Friday’s concert also opened with ‘Prelude To The End’, the band’s new animated short film featuring voice contributions from Billie Eilish, Phoebe Bridgers and more.

The group return to the Hollywood Bowl tonight (October 31) for the final concert of their residency, before continuing their world tour in Asia next month.

Source: https://www.nme.com/news/music/my-chemical-romance-gerard-way-plans-new-album-2027-touring-2028-3974719?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=my-chemical-romance-gerard-way-plans-new-album-2027-touring-2028

posts.title: Kelly Clarkson Wins One & Loses One at 2026 Daytime Emmys
posts.excerpt: “Birdgate” had no bearing on the outcome. Voting concluded months ago.
posts.content:
The Kelly Clarkson Show won outstanding daytime talk series at the 2026 Daytime Emmys on Friday (Oct. 30), though its star, Kelly Clarkson, lost outstanding daytime talk series host to Sherri Shepherd for Sherri.

Clarkson won in one or both of those categories in six of the show’s seven seasons on the air. She has won a total of nine Daytime Emmys in seven years – five in the talk series category and four for talk series host – compared to three Grammys in a recording career which has lasted more than 20 years. Clarkson wasn’t present at the ceremony, which was held at the Hollywood Palladium for the first time.

Related

Kelly Clarkson to End Daytime Talk Show After 7 Years

Kelly Clarkson Is a Double Winner Again at 2023 Daytime Emmys

Kelly Clarkson Wins One, Loses One at 2024 Daytime Emmys

Clarkson recently made headlines for an incident at a curiosity shop in Brooklyn where she maintained that she was treated poorly. But “Birdgate” had no bearing on the outcome here. There is just one round of Daytime Emmy voting, which determines both the nominations and the eventual winner. That round closed on June 10, four months before the incident.

The Kelly Clarkson Show won three other awards this year – best directing for a daytime studio non-fiction series; outstanding sound mixing and sound editing for a live daytime program; and outstanding art direction/set decoration/scenic design for a daytime program.

Ray Chew won outstanding music direction and composition for a daytime program for Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. His award was accepted by his wife, who explained that he was busy working on Dancing With the Stars. Chew has also served in music direction capacities on American Idol, Saturday Night Live, the Emmy Awards, the BET Awards and the Grammy Awards’ Premiere Ceremony.

Keke Palmer won her first Daytime Emmy – outstanding daytime short form program as producer of Glam Through the Ages. Palmer has won two Primetime Emmys, for Keke Palmer’s Turnt Up With the Taylors and the reboot of Password.

Tracee Ellis Ross won outstanding travel and adventure program for Solo Traveling With Tracee Ellis Ross. It’s her first Emmy Award (Daytime or Primetime) following six Primetime Emmy nods for ABC’s blackish. Ross’ legendary mom, Diana Ross, has yet to win an Emmy.

Off Script With The Hollywood Reporter won outstanding arts and popular culture program, beating a pair of programs produced by their sister brand, Variety – Variety & CNN Actors on Actors and Variety Studio: Actors on Actors.

Star Jones won her first Daytime Emmy in a 35-year TV career – outstanding daytime personality – daily for Divorce Court, which she won alongside Corey Jovan. Jones thanked two late legends who she described as “her two mentors – Johnnie Cochran, who taught me about justice, and Barbara Walters, who taught me to ask the tough question.”

General Hospital won outstanding daytime drama series for the sixth consecutive year – and 19th time overall, both records. Runner-up for most total wins in the category is The Young and The Restless, with 11 wins.

Genie Francis received a lifetime achievement award to celebrate her soon-to-be 50th anniversary playing Laura Spencer on General Hospital. Her co-star on that show, Anthony Geary, the other half of the Luke & Laura storyline which took daytime drama to new heights in the early 1980s, died in December 2025. He was remembered in the In Memoriam segment alongside critic Gene Shalit and such other actors as June Lockhart and Sally Kirkland.

This is the second year in a row that the Daytime Emmys didn’t air on linear TV. Instead, the ceremony streamed live on the NATAS YouTube channel at YouTube.com/@theemmys and watch.TheEmmys.tv.

The full list of winners is available on the Daytime Emmys’ website. Here are the nominees in the two talk show categories and other categories of special interest to the music community, with winners marked.
