posts.title: Och’Idoma seeks stronger action against hunger, malnutrition in Benue
posts.excerpt: The Och’Idoma, HRM Agaba’Idu Elaigwu Odogbo John, has urged the leadership of the MATAN Food Bank Foundation to translate its 21-Pillar Initiative into practical projects capable of addressing hunger,
posts.content:
The Och’Idoma, HRM Agaba’Idu Elaigwu Odogbo John, has urged the leadership of the MATAN Food Bank Foundation to translate its 21-Pillar Initiative into practical projects capable of addressing hunger, food insecurity and other developmental challenges facing communities.

The paramount ruler of the Idoma nation made the call during the commissioning of the foundation’s office in Makurdi, Benue State on Thursday.

He urged members to ensure that the initiative produces measurable results rather than remaining an organisational vision or a mere slogan.

He emphasised that the effectiveness of the programme would be determined by its implementation and the positive impact it makes on people's lives, rather than the number of projects announced.

According to him, “The concept of the pillar signifies strength, stability, structure and sustainability. However, these pillars must be more than an attractive concept or organisational slogan.

"Each must represent a clear development objective, a practical implementation strategy and measurable results.”

The royal father urged the foundation to establish clear implementation plans for each of the 21 pillars, prioritising agricultural advancement, food security, youth involvement in agribusiness, women's economic empowerment and poverty reduction.

He listed support for small-scale farmers, community food banks, humanitarian food supplies, food processing and preservation facilities, agricultural funding, cooperative societies and improved market access as key areas that should receive attention.

Other areas he identified included vocational training, professional capacity building, employment generation, environmentally sustainable farming, modern agricultural technology and community-based economic empowerment.

He noted that Benue State could achieve greater economic growth if its vast agricultural resources were supported with adequate investment, improved farming methods and opportunities for farmers to process their produce and increase its value.

“Our land must not merely remain a symbol of agricultural potential; it must become an instrument of economic prosperity for our people,” he declared.

On the contribution of traditional institutions to the initiative, the monarch described traditional rulers as important stakeholders in grassroots development because of their familiarity with local communities, cultural practices, land matters and the everyday challenges confronting their people.

He encouraged the foundation to build stronger working relationships with traditional rulers and community leaders across Benue State and other parts of the country to facilitate the mobilisation of residents and effective implementation of its programmes.

According to him, traditional institutions could play significant roles in motivating youths to see agriculture as a viable business, encouraging farmers to adopt modern techniques, strengthening cooperative groups and creating better opportunities for processing and marketing agricultural produce.

The Och’Idoma also advocated partnerships with federal, state and local governments, financial institutions, agricultural professionals, private sector investors, and local and international development organisations.

He cautioned the foundation against operating with the belief that its members had all the expertise needed to achieve the initiative's objectives, urging them to welcome constructive advice and contributions from individuals with different experiences.

He stressed that meaningful ideas could emerge from people who might otherwise be overlooked, adding that consultation and willingness to learn were necessary for the organisation's growth and success.

The traditional ruler further urged the leadership and members to make transparency, accountability and integrity guiding principles, especially in handling the foundation's financial resources.

He warned that poor financial management and a lack of openness could damage an organisation's credibility and discourage public support as well as assistance from development partners.

Speaking at the occasion, the National Group Vice-President of the association, Comrade David Ida, explained that the 21-pillar framework was established to tackle hunger and nutritional deficiencies through coordinated interventions covering food production, processing, distribution and community-based support.

Ida, who also doubles as the National Contact and Mobilisation Officer, said the foundation's responsibility extended beyond supplying food to people in need, noting that access to sufficient, safe and nutritionally balanced meals was equally important in addressing malnutrition.

He disclosed that the organisation planned to engage directly in agricultural production while putting measures in place to guarantee the quality and safety of food supplied to the public.

He added that food items would be subjected to laboratory examinations and appropriate medical certification before being cleared for consumption.

Och’Idoma seeks stronger action against hunger, malnutrition in Benue

posts.title: Portugal: Ronaldo's 5 defining moments in national team shirt after retirement
posts.excerpt: Cristiano Ronaldo brought his international career to a close on Thursday, ending more than two decades representing Portugal. From his 2003 debut to a record 146 goals in 234 appearances, here are fi
posts.content:
Cristiano Ronaldo brought his international career to a close on Thursday, ending more than two decades representing Portugal.

From his 2003 debut to a record 146 goals in 234 appearances, here are five performances that stand out in the Seleção shirt.

2018: A one-man show against Spain

Ronaldo arrived at the 2018 World Cup opener fresh from three consecutive Champions League triumphs with Real Madrid, and he took charge against Spain in Sochi.

He gave Portugal the lead from the penalty spot, then completed a hat-trick—capped by a brilliant late free kick—to earn a dramatic draw.

2025: Still delivering at 40

Just three months after his 40th birthday, Ronaldo helped Portugal reach the Nations League final against Spain in Munich.

He scored the winner against Germany in the semi-final, then equalised against Spain to force extra time. Portugal went on to win on penalties, six years after lifting the same trophy.

2013: Getting the better of Zlatan

Portugal led Sweden 1-0 after the play-off first leg, thanks to their iconic No. 7, and headed to Stockholm for the return. Ronaldo struck first, but Zlatan Ibrahimovic’s double pulled Sweden level in the tie. Ronaldo then sealed Portugal’s place at the 2014 World Cup in Brazil by completing his hat-trick within two minutes.

2016: Tears, then triumph

Portugal reached the Euro 2016 final without winning a group game. Against hosts France in Paris, they were chasing their first major international trophy and trying to erase the pain of losing to Greece at home 12 years earlier.

Ronaldo was forced off injured and in tears after 25 minutes, but he spent the rest of the match on the touchline urging his teammates on. Eder’s extra-time goal delivered relief for Ronaldo and 11 million Portuguese fans.

2026: Toronto turnaround

After an uninspiring group stage, Ronaldo and Portugal met Croatia in the last 32 of the 2026 World Cup in Toronto. Aware that it could be his final World Cup match, Ronaldo took control.

An early effort was ruled out for offside, and Ivan Perisic put Croatia ahead, but Ronaldo equalised from the penalty spot. Goncalo Ramos’ late header secured a memorable 2-1 win and a place in the last 16, where Portugal lost to eventual champions Spain.

Portugal: Ronaldo's 5 defining moments in national team shirt after retirement

posts.title: Charles Barkley rips bold trick-or-treaters or ask him to sign their basketball cards
posts.excerpt: Charles Barkley called out trick-or-treaters who showed up at his door with basketball cards, demanding he sign autographs along with candy.
posts.content:
Halloween is in the books, which means that if your household is anything like mine, you will soon be tasked with hanging Christmas lights on the front porch. However, NBA great Charles Barkley still has one Halloween-related gripe he needs to get off his chest.

He's got some bold kids in his neighborhood who aren't content with just a fun-sized Snickers bar or a pack of Skittles Gummies (which are actually very good, by the way); they want the Round Mound of Rebound to grab a Sharpie and sign their basketball cards.

On a recent edition of "Inside the NBA," Barkley took a moment to address the youngsters — I think we need to assume they're youngsters, but who knows? — who were looking to add something with some resale value to their jack-o'-lantern candy buckets.

CHARLES BARKLEY CALLS OUT LEBRON JAMES FOR DISRESPECTING THE NATIONAL ANTHEM WITH PRACTICE GOLF SWING

"Hey, let me tell you something," Barkley began. "You damn brats need to stop bringing basketball cards and stuff to my damn house. I'm giving you damn candy; I'm not there to sign autographs all night.

"I'm gonna let y'all get away with that this one damn time..."

COOPER FLAGG ROOKIE CARD MAKES EYE-POPPING RECORD SALE, BUT IS IT ACTUALLY A GOOD INVESTMENT?

I can understand the frustration. This is premeditated. I don't think many kids are keeping Barkley cards in their wallets at all times on the off chance they run into him while dressed as a pirate, football player, or inflatable Minion.

However, weirdly, I respect the boldness. Those kids are go-getters.

That said, they may want to leave their binders at home next year.

"I love being home and giving the kids candy," Barkley continued. "But now they're bringing cards. You can't be mean to kids. I wanted to punch them in the face, but I couldn't do it."

CHARLES BARKLEY JOKINGLY WARNS 'INSIDE THE NBA' CREW ABOUT SHAQUILLE O'NEAL'S FBI CONNECTION

So there you have it, trick-or-treaters: quit being greedy.

Take your Twizzlers and then move on to the next house where you can just dump the whole bowl of candy into your pillowcase.

Leave Chuck alone.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/outkick-sports/charles-barkley-rips-bold-trick-or-treaters-ask-him-sign-basketball-cards

posts.title: Schumer faces mutiny from newly elected Senate Dems as party prepares to seize power
posts.excerpt: Senate Democrats face a leadership battle as Chuck Schumer seeks to keep his role, but several newly elected senators are pushing for new blood.
posts.content:
Senate Democrats will soon decide who will lead them with their newly acquired grip on power in the upper chamber, and while Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., appears to be the favorite, some in the caucus aren’t eager to back him.

Schumer has led Senate Democrats for nearly a decade, helming the caucus as both majority and minority leader since 2017. But many of the fresh crop of Democratic senators-elect, which span the ideological gamut from moderate to progressive, are tepid, at best, in backing him for another term.

And some said throughout their campaigns that they wouldn’t support him at all.

DEM SENATE HOPEFUL REJECTS SCHUMER BUT BENEFITS FROM MILLIONS IN SPENDING BY HIS ALLIES

"I mean no disrespect for Chuck Schumer, but we need new leadership," Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton told CNN in September. "We need new younger leadership, young blood."

Hamilton is the moderate megachurch pastor who toppled Sen. Roger Marshall, R-Kan., on Election Night, flipping the Sunflower State for the first time in nearly a century. He, like others this cycle, argued that Democrats needed "fresh ideas and fresh leadership."

"In Kansas, Chuck Schumer is a liability for Democrats, and we've got to have leaders that can unite us, bring us together, not just Democrats, but bring together Democrats and Republicans to solve real problems," he said. "And I think people are frustrated with the gridlock in the sense that people are not working together to solve problems."

Democrats are expected to hold their leadership elections later this year, and Schumer will have to shore up support within his newly expanded caucus to stay at the top. But he will only need a majority of Senate Democrats to back him.

REPORTER'S NOTEBOOK: CONGRESS BRACES FOR POST-ELECTION GAME OF MUSICAL CHAIRS AS LEADERSHIP BATTLES LOOM

So far, Democrats’ majority in the upper chamber is at 54 seats and could further expand depending on the results in Mississippi and Alaska, which as of Thursday were leaning in their favor.

Schumer believed that he would still be the one to lead Democrats and contended to reporters on Wednesday that issues that incoming senators and their voters may have had with the direction of the Democratic Party in recent years were not about him.

"The issue is not me," Schumer said. "I'll be re-elected as majority leader, but the issue is focusing on the American people and what they want."

Still, there is a faction of newcomers, including senators-elect Troy Jackson in Maine, Julianna Stratton in Illinois, Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan and Peggy Flanagan in Minnesota, who aren’t all in for Schumer.

THUNE GOES ALL-IN ON CAMPAIGN TRAIL AS SCHUMER STAYS ON BENCH, FACES REJECTION FROM FELLOW DEMS

Jackson, speaking to reporters just before Election Day, said his position hadn’t changed on Schumer.

"I told Schumer that I’m going to, you know, support somebody else," Jackson said. "So it’s no different now."

That somebody else could be Sen. Chris Van Hollen, D-Md., who has been proposed as an alternative by progressives, like El-Sayed, to lead Senate Democrats instead of Schumer. Van Hollen may have his eyes elsewhere — he has said that he’s "kicking the tires" on a 2028 run.

A Democratic aide familiar with Van Hollen’s thinking told Fox News Digital that before selecting a new leader, the lawmaker believed "the caucus needs to have an honest and open conversation about how we move an agenda forward that reflects the will of the American people."

"He’s made it clear that the new Democratic majorities need to use their power to push a proactive, economic agenda," they said.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/politics/schumer-faces-mutiny-from-newly-elected-senate-dems-party-prepares-seize-power

posts.title: Adult film star had no idea she was MLB player's side chick until he got engaged, Lindsey Vonn's happy & more
posts.excerpt: Silvia Saige claims she dated Royals pitcher Bruce Chen for around eight months with first-class flights to away games before learning he was engaged.
posts.content:
Welcome to the latest edition of True Romance. I'm back from vacation, and I'd like to say that I'm well rested and fully prepared for the next couple of months before 2027 arrives, but I try my best not to lie.

The truth is, I'm not well rested at all. It's the first Thursday in November already and Thanksgiving is right around the corner. But that doesn’t mean we're not going to make the most of it. We are.

I'm loaded up with caffeine. That's a good thing, because we have a lot to get to. The first order of business this week is the sad news that came out a few days ago. As a supporter of love, it was truly tough news to swallow.

THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW!

I'm, of course, talking about the breakup of Bill Belichick and Jordon Hudson. I thought these two were going to make it. Unfortunately, they called it quits last year, but remain close friends and business partners.

So, who knows what the future holds for these two and their nearly 50-year age gap? The reason for the split, according to the Daily Mail, was that the relationship became a distraction. Neither of them wanted that.

"Looking back, that was a big part of what pulled his focus away from football last season," the Daily Mail reported.

"He was thinking about taking the next steps with her, getting engaged, getting married, and building a future together, while also dealing with the constant attention and outside scrutiny that came with being in such a high-profile relationship. It became overwhelming for both of them."

Enough about these two. Let's get to the reality of dating a professional athlete. If you're only invited to attend road games, there's a decent chance you're the side chick. An adult film star says she found this out the hard way.

Plus, Lindsey Vonn has a relationship update that she felt the need to share. But don't expect these updates to take place on a regular basis going forward.

Go follow True Romance on Twitter and Facebook and keep sending your emails here: sean.joseph@outkick.com (anonymously if you prefer).

Who among us doesn’t love a good story about baseball and romance? We all remember "Bull Durham," don't we?

Adult film actress Silvia Saige claimed on the "Holly Randall Unfiltered" podcast that she once dated former MLB pitcher Bruce Chen while he was a member of the Kansas City Royals.

Chen was close to the end of his career at the time, she said. The two met, according to Saige, thanks to Eric Hosmer while she was doing promotional modeling in Kansas City before she got into porn.

"I had gone to an event and I had actually gone home, and I'll say this guy's name too, cause f--- him, I truly hate this man, Eric Hosmer, was our first baseman at the time and he and I had kind of hit it off at the event," Saige said. "So I went home with him."

She alleged that he kicked her out of his place after she refused to sleep with him. She assumes Chen got her phone number from Hosmer after he bragged about it in the locker room the next day.

'CHARLIE'S ANGELS' ACTRESS CLAIMS COSTAR INVITED HER TO THREESOME, A CONTRABAND BRA FOR LOVE & NO HARM NO FOUL

Saige continued, "He (Chen) had hit me up, and he said, you know, 'I would like to take you out, and I would like to show you how a woman should be treated, because what Eric did to you was completely wrong, and I'm so sorry, let me make that up to you.'"

She said that Chen did make it up to her. He flew her out to an away game first class like a gentleman for their first date and pulled out all the stops once she arrived.

"When I got there, the doorman knew my name and what I was wearing and escorted me up," Saige claimed. "I had a massage table waiting and money to go shopping."

None of that was a red flag to her. She thought going all out with the red carpet treatment was how it was supposed to be. They ended up dating for several months, and he even met her family, according to Saige.

The entire time, it was first-class flights to away games and "service, service, service." Around eight months into the relationship is when she found out that she was the side chick.

That news was delivered by a phone call from her aunt. Saige said that her uncle had seen on the news that Chen was engaged.

She called Chen up, and he confirmed that he was going to marry someone else, but that he would still like to see her too. According to her, he offered her money.

"It was like, you know like, 'I'll pay your bills and keep you happy,'" she told host Holly Randall.

That wasn’t an arrangement she was willing to knowingly enter into at the time. She genuinely thought she was in a real relationship and turned it down. The invites to only away games didn’t give it away that there was someone else.

Ladies, if you're romantically involved with an athlete, and you're only being invited to away games, take it as a sign. There's a good chance you're not the starter on their roster.

SIGN UP FOR THE DAILY OUTKICK NEWSLETTER

Follow True Romance on Twitter and Facebook.

No, Lindsey Vonn isn't engaged to her boyfriend, fellow alpine skier Matthieu Bailet. She just wants you to know that she's "really happy" about her "amazing boyfriend," she told People.

Now to be fair to her, she told People that at a fashion awards show where the outlet likely asked her about her relationship. But don't expect too many of these kinds of updates. She's not trying to put it in everyone’s face.

"I think in my past it’s kind of been mixed of keeping things private and maybe oversharing. I’m trying to strike a nice balance," Vonn said.

"He’s awesome and I wanted to share that. People know now I’m dating someone, and I’m happy, but I’m not going to share too much moving forward."

Good for her. It's the right call. Finding the perfect balance and picking your spots to show off your boyfriend shirtless while in a bikini isn't done enough.

It's a "look at me" society we live in. I like those who are able to show restraint.

You know Lindsey Vonn is dating someone. Boom, they're hot together in swimwear, and happy, then they keep it to themselves again for a while.

That's a couple you can root for. They're not proposing in your face on the jumbotron trying to make everything all about them.

It's an occasional behind the scenes, don't we look good in our underwear? The answer is yes. Yes, you do. We'll all be here for your next partially clothed relationship update. Until then, we wish you nothing but the best.

As you might have guessed, there are a lot of not-so-great outcomes from marrying a bad boy. But what about those who beat the odds?

The ones who have made it work for 40 years even after being stood up on their first date because the bad boy was helping his girlfriend move out.

That's what we're all chasing. Isn't it? A little bit of magic in places nobody else is willing to look. There will be failure, but what about the ones that succeed?

Here's some of the good, the bad, and the sometimes ugly:

-------------

That's all I have for today. We've made it to November and we all know the romance doesn’t stop because we're creeping up on the holidays.

posts.title: LIV Golf is officially over after announcing plans to 'wind-down' operations after failed rescue deal
posts.excerpt: LIV Golf plans to liquidate assets after BC Partners scrapped its $300 million rescue deal when key players failed to commit before the deadline.
posts.content:
LIV Golf is dead.

The remaining powers that be were working to manufacture some form of a second edition of the circuit despite having no funding and an entirely unknown roster of players, but the white flag has officially been waved after five seasons.

During a bankruptcy court hearing held on Thursday, LIV Golf's lawyers shared plans for the circuit to begin liquidating its assets, with the process expected to begin on Nov. 9. LIV Golf released a statement following the hearing, announcing that it "intends to transition to an orderly wind-down of its operations."

RORY MCILROY MAKES SERIOUS ACCUSATION ABOUT LIV GOLF WANTING TO 'DESTROY' THE EUROPEAN TOUR

Nothing about LIV officially closing up shop is a surprise given recent developments.

In April, the Saudi Arabia Public Investment Fund (PIF) announced that it would cease funding the circuit at the end of the 2026 season. The Saudi PIF was the sole funder of LIV, and following a reported $266 million injection into the league for 2026, was set to reach $6 billion invested dating back to 2021.

With the never-ending spigot of cash shut off by the Saudis, LIV filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September, but was quickly tossed a lifeline by BC Partners in the form of a $300 million pledged investment to navigate through the proceedings and, in theory, be suited to launch 'LIV 2.0' when all the dust had settled.

On Wednesday, LIV's lifeline disappeared. BC Partners scrapped the planned rescue deal after the circuit failed to get any firm commitments from the few high-profile players who had yet to officially announce their departure from the circuit.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE

According to The Athletic, BC Partners had secured signatures from more than 30 players willing to compete on 'LIV 2.0,' but 10 additional players of higher-profile status failed to commit before the Oct. 25 deadline that was given.

"We thank our partners at the PIF for their collaboration and support, and BC Partners Credit for its engagement throughout this process," LIV CEO Scott O'Neil said in a statement. "We are also deeply grateful to our employees, Board, advisors, and fans around the world, whose dedication, resilience, and belief made this remarkable journey possible. Golf has given so much to so many, and my hope is that those entrusted with its future will lead with the generosity, perspective, and shared purpose this extraordinary game deserves."

LIV Golf was originally formed in October 2021 before the league hosted its inaugural tournament in England in June 2022. Its initial events were contested over three days, consisting of no-cut, 54-hole tournaments with guaranteed paydays for every player in the field.

The circuit was able to poach many stars away from the PGA Tour, including Bryson DeChambeau, Jon Rahm, Brooks Koepka, Dustin Johnson, and Phil Mickelson, with the incentives of a limited schedule and nine-figure signing bonuses in some cases.

Koepka (2023 PGA Championship) and DeChambeau (2024 U.S. Open) were the two lone players to win a major championship while competing on LIV.

PGA TOUR CEO BRIAN ROLAPP REITERATES IT IS NOT CONSIDERING A RETURNING MEMBER PROGRAM FOR LIV GOLFERS

The playing fate of former LIV golfers looking to return to the PGA Tour is unknown at this moment. Koepka returned to the Tour at the beginning of 2026 after taking advantage of a now non-existent Returning Members Program that included many penalties and financial requirements.

With LIV no longer in operation, players who stood alongside the circuit until the final minutes – which includes DeChambeau – do not hold any leverage with the PGA Tour and DP World Tour, which now hold the only cards in the game.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/outkick-sports/liv-golf-officially-over-announcing-plans-wind-down-operations-failed-rescue-deal

posts.title: Schumer, Jeffries sidestep questions on nuking filibuster, launching Elon Musk probe after blue wave
posts.excerpt: Chuck Schumer ignored questions twice about abolishing the filibuster as Democrats prepare to take the Senate majority after midterm victories.
posts.content:
Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., and House minority leader Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., did not answer Fox News Digital’s questions about their potential first moves in Congress as the Democrats won back the majority in both chambers with sweeping victories in Tuesday’s elections.

Schumer was pressed on whether he plans to abolish the filibuster as speculation grows that Democrats could eliminate the filibuster after President Donald Trump urged Senate Republicans to terminate it numerous times to pass the SAVE America Act. Trump previously warned that if Republicans didn’t act on it, the Democrats would if given the opportunity — which they now have.

Schumer ignored the question after being asked twice by Fox News Digital if he plans to eliminate it.

FETTERMAN STRONGLY SUPPORTS THE FILIBUSTER AS TRUMP URGES SENATE REPUBLICANS TO SCRAP IT

The question comes as some Democrats have previously signaled openness to eliminating the filibuster if they regained the Senate.

During a press conference Wednesday morning, Schumer also refused to answer questions about some of his plans for the Senate as they take back the majority — including eliminating the filibuster. He also said that he will be "re-elected as majority leader" by the Senate Democratic caucus, despite opposition from newly elected Democrats. He quickly redirected the conversation to focus on the blue wave in the midterm elections and what the party plans to do with the "generational remake of the Senate map."

SCHUMER SAYS HE'S NOT GOING ANYWHERE, BUT HIS OWN CANDIDATES AREN'T READY TO BACK HIM

Jeffries was also asked by Fox News Digital about the looming question over whether Democrats will probe Elon Musk after the party has begun eyeing targets in their discussed efforts to investigate alleged corruption in the Trump administration.

Jeffries gave Fox News Digital a thumbs-up when approached but did not respond when asked whether House Democrats would investigate Musk.

Musk has emerged as a potential target of Democratic oversight, with some lawmakers calling for scrutiny of his time as head of the Department of Government Efficiency. Democratic lawmakers have also suggested looking into this companies' multibillion-dollar contracts with the federal government, and more recently, his role in cutting internet access to the Ukrainian military.

‘LAWYER UP’: DEMS IMMEDIATELY PUT TRUMP ON NOTICE AMID REPUBLICANS' MIDTERM BLOODBATH

The House Minority Leader’s refusal to comment comes as Democrats are divided over whether they would select Jeffries as Speaker of the House. There was a petition started that has received over 550,000 to oust Jeffries from leading the House, arguing the party needs a Speaker that represents "the Democratic voters, not just the Democratic establishment."

With many of the newly elected congressional candidates hesitant, or outright opposed, to back both Jeffries and Schumer as leaders, the decision over who will be the leaders of both chambers of Congress is still in limbo.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/politics/schumer-jeffries-sidestep-questions-nuking-filibuster-launching-elon-musk-probe-blue-wave

posts.title: Melania Trump: Oleshky ceasefire is a ‘spark’ for 'more enduring' peace between Ukraine, Russia
posts.excerpt: Melania Trump called the Oleshky ceasefire "a spark in a world of darkness" as Russian and Ukrainian envoys praised the deal at a rare White House event.
posts.content:
First lady Melania Trump and peace envoys from both Russia and Ukraine spoke from the White House on Thursday, hailing the ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Oleshky region as a potential "spark" for peace that lasts beyond a temporary regional ceasefire.

"We have chosen humanity over war," the first lady said in a White House trilateral news conference with the two warring countries. "Undeniably, the lives of innocent people must transcend the division of war. I hope Oleshky inspires greater peace. Every significant transformation begins with a small spark."

"Together, we can create something more enduring than a temporary ceasefire," she added, calling Oleshky "a spark in a world of darkness capable of illuminating the best in humanity."

INSIDE MELANIA TRUMP'S SECRET DIPLOMATIC ROLE IN THE RUSSIA-UKRAINE CEASEFIRE DEAL

Trump said she became aware of a humanitarian crisis in the region in September and directed her representative, Marc Beckman, to engage with Russia and Ukraine on her behalf. She said both countries agreed to work with her as an "exclusive intermediary" to establish a ceasefire in Oleshky and the surrounding Kherson region, deliver humanitarian aid and create a safe evacuation route for civilians.

Her remarks were followed by comments from Russian special envoy Kirill Dmitriev, who said Russian President Vladimir Putin appreciated President Donald Trump’s efforts to stop the fighting.

US WILL MEDIATE UPCOMING UKRAINE-RUSSIA TALKS IN ABU DHABI, WITKOFF SAYS

"President Putin also appreciates President Trump's peacemaking effort and his team working on a peace plan to resolve Ukrainian crisis," Dmitriev said in a rare moment of a Russian diplomat speaking at the White House. "President Trump has asked President Putin to support a number of initiatives on exchanging of prisoners, on releasing U.S. prisoners on humanitarian efforts. And President Putin supported those ideas and those initiatives."

"And it's very important that cooperation between Russia and Ukraine and Russia in the United States matters not only for our two nations, but for the entire world," he continued. "Let us continue making great humanitarian contributions. We can together, let us build a future of peace, partnership and prosperity for the benefit of our families, our children and future generations."

RUSSIA RELEASES AMERICAN TEACHER IMPRISONED ON UKRAINE MERCENARY CHARGES AFTER TRUMP PRESSED PUTIN

"Dear Melania, you saved and touched so many lives," he concluded.

David Arakhamia, the leader of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's political party, called Melania Trump's ceasefire the 'biggest de-escalation since 2022," when the war began.

UKRAINE'S ZELENSKYY OPEN TO FREEZING FRONT LINES IN CEASEFIRE WITH RUSSIA

"Madam first lady, I would like to thank you: You did an amazing job," he said. "I think when everything started with you and your team, we had about 5% of people who believed in success, and 95% of skeptics who said it wasn’t going to work. Now, after it happened, it’s switched completely: 95% of the people believe that we can do things like that, and 5% are still skeptical."

Peace is now a matter of when, not if, he added.

KUSHNER, WITKOFF SET FOR KYIV TALKS AFTER PUTIN MEETING IN US PUSH FOR PEACE

Getting fearful Ukrainians out of the Russian-controlled city is an important step toward deciding how peace will be made and determining the long-term fate of the occupied territory of southern Ukraine.

"On the first day, people in the area did not believe it was happening," Arakhamia said. "They stayed in their homes, waiting to see if the clock was ticking backward. The next day, they started walking around their homes. The day after that, they came to see their broken homes and find their belongings.

"This is really emotional to watch and supervise, to understand what we are doing," he added. "I think we are creating momentum where both sides are learning the little mechanics of how to keep the peace when the peace comes.

"I would also like to sincerely thank you, from my heart, for doing this."

Dmitriev attended the event and met with U.S. officials, sources told Reuters. Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine's human rights ombudsman, also attended the event.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/world/melania-trump-oleshky-ceasefire-spark-more-enduring-peace-ukraine-russia

posts.title: Atiku Takes Presidential Campaign To Kebbi, Pledges To Restore Fuel Subsidy
posts.excerpt: The Kebbi rally came hours after a Federal High Court in Abuja nullified the David Mark-led ADC leadership and voided Atiku’s emergence as the party’s presidential candidate. The post Atiku Takes Pres
posts.content:
The presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Atiku Abubakar, has pledged to restore fuel subsidy, improve security and create employment if elected president in 2027.

Atiku made the pledge on Thursday during a campaign rally in Kebbi State, where he called on voters to support the ADC, describing it as the only party committed to addressing the three issues.

“The people of Kebbi State, let me ask you a few questions. Do you want the return of subsidy? Do you want security? Do you want employment? Therefore you have no option other than the ADC. ADC is the only political party that is committed to these three objectives and more to bring about prosperity, unity and peace to the people of our country,” he said.

The former Vice President and his running mate also criticised some projects being presented as achievements of the President Bola Tinubu administration, describing them as legacies of the late President Muhammadu Buhari.

Supporters of the ADC gathered at the party’s secretariat in Birnin Kebbi to welcome Atiku and other party chieftains ahead of the rally.

Speaking at the event, the Director-General of the ADC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Austin Akobundu, commended party faithful for what he described as their resistance to intimidation by the state government.

Akobundu said the 2027 general elections would be a referendum between suffering Nigerians and the Federal Government under President Tinubu.

The ADC National Chairman, in his remarks, described the party as a moving train that no amount of intimidation could stop.

He called on the people of Kebbi State to vote for Atiku as president, Abubakar Malami as governor and other ADC candidates in the 2027 general elections.

The rally ended with the ADC National Chairman formally presenting the party’s flag to Malami as the party’s governorship candidate for the 2027 election.

Crowd at Atiku Abubakar’s presidential campaign rally in Kebbi.

The campaign in Kebbi came hours after a Federal High Court in Abuja nullified the leadership of the Senator David Mark-led ADC and voided the actions taken by the party’s executives, including the process that produced Atiku as its presidential candidate.

Justice Peter Lifu delivered the judgment in a suit filed by Nafiu Bala Gombe, a former National Deputy Chairman of the party, who challenged the emergence of the Mark-led leadership.

Atiku rejected the ruling, describing it as an attempt to weaken his political support and frustrate his campaign. He said he would challenge the judgment at the Court of Appeal.

The ADC also rejected the decision, accusing the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) of attempting to cripple the opposition and vowing to challenge the judgment through all available judicial processes.

Source: https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/05/atiku-takes-presidential-campaign-to-kebbi-pledges-to-restore-fuel-subsidy/

posts.title: Tinubu Congratulates Flamingos, Backs Team To Win U-17 World Cup
posts.excerpt: The President described the team’s qualification for the final as a remarkable achievement that has brought immense pride and joy to millions of Nigerians at home and abroad. The post Tinubu Congratul
posts.content:
President Bola Tinubu has congratulated Nigeria’s U-17 women’s national football team, the Flamingos, on their 3-1 victory over Brazil in Wednesday’s semi-final of the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco.

In a statement issued by his media aide, Bayo Onanuga, the President described the team’s qualification for the final as a remarkable achievement that has brought immense pride and joy to millions of Nigerians at home and abroad.

Tinubu also commended the coaching crew and everyone whose hard work and support contributed to the team’s successful campaign.

As the Flamingos prepare to face Japan in the final, the President urged the players to remain focused, confident and determined, assuring them of the prayers, goodwill and unwavering support of Nigerians.

“I encourage you to approach the final with the same fighting spirit and belief that have brought you this far. I have confidence in your ability to make history by winning the coveted world title.

“I call on all Nigerians to rally behind the young ambassadors of the nation, whose achievements continue to showcase Nigeria’s sporting excellence and inspire a new generation of girls to pursue their dreams uninhibited.

“Once again, Nigeria is proud of you. Go for the trophy, Flamingos!” he added.

President Bola Tinubu

The Flamingos reached the final of the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup for the first time after defeating Brazil 3-1 in their semi-final encounter in Morocco.

The Nigerian girls produced a spirited second-half performance, scoring three goals before Brazil grabbed a late consolation.

Queen Joseph opened the scoring in the 56th minute, finishing off an assist from Oluwakemi Adegubyi to give Nigeria the lead.

The Flamingos doubled their advantage in the 71st minute when Awawu Bashiru found the net, with Joseph providing the assist.

Bashiru struck again in the 80th minute to make it 3-0, converting a pass from Oluebube Umejiaku as Nigeria took firm control of the encounter.

Brazil pulled one back in the 89th minute through Greise Kelly, assisted by Yasmin Queiroz, but the goal came too late to prevent Nigeria from securing victory and a place in the final.

Source: https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/05/tinubu-congratulates-flamingos-backs-team-to-win-u-17-world-cup/

posts.title: 2027 Campaigns: Presidency Seeks Caution In Use Of AI By Parties
posts.excerpt: Deji Elumoye in Abuja The Presidency on Thursday called on politicians to seek caution in the deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) as the 2027 electioneering gathers momentum. Presidential spoke
posts.content:
Deji Elumoye in Abuja

The Presidency on Thursday called on politicians to seek caution in the deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) as the 2027 electioneering gathers momentum.

Presidential spokesperson, Bayo Onanuga, canvassed for responsible and cautious deployment of AI in the course of political activities and campaigns ahead of the 2027 polls.

He warned that while the scientific breakthrough has had positive effects, it is now imperative to put guardrails in place to protect the sanctity of democratic institutions and public trust.

Onanuga made the call in Beijing, China, while delivering a paper, ‘AI and the Future of Global Communication,’ at the 7th World Media Summit organised by Xinhua News Agency and the People’s Government of Beijing Municipality.

According to him, social media, including X, Facebook and TikTok, are inundated with AI-generated videos and images to promote political interests and entertain.

His words: “We are in the thick of the political season and campaigns ahead of the 2027 general election, where new political leaders at the national and sub-national levels will be elected. AI, for good and bad, has become a powerful tool for electoral contests for politicians and their supporters.

“Some political actors use AI to spread falsehoods, some use it satirically for entertainment, and some highlight candidates’ achievements.”

The presidential aide said the growing influence of AI in political communication makes it imperative for stakeholders- political actors, media organisations, and the general public to exercise greater responsibility in content creation and sharing.

Onanuga acknowledged that AI’s growing contributions, including innovations in medicine and major feats in mathematics, make it an indispensable tool for improving the lot of humanity.

“Today, AI governs our existence, and we encounter it all the time. In the car, it warns you about your immediate surroundings. It maps your fastest route to your destination. We can go on, citing AI’s Leviathan impact on our lives.

“I believe we can no longer ignore AI’s penetrating impact, most of it beneficial, unless we want to return to the Stone Age,” he added.

Onanuga expressed optimism that stakeholders, including individuals, scientists and governments such as the United Nations, are equally concerned about AI’s direction and are pushing for necessary controls.

“The world must act before it becomes too late. Build guardrails quickly to save humanity,” he further stated.

Source: https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/2027-campaigns-presidency-seeks-caution-in-use-of-ai-by-parties/

posts.title: Omotola Predicts Tight 2027 Race, Gives Tinubu Slim Lead Over Obi, Atiku
posts.excerpt: Funmi Ogundare The Publisher of Politico.ng, under the Political Intelligence Group, Lai Omotola, Thursday, projected President Bola Ahmed Tinubu as maintaining a slim lead over former Anambra State G
posts.content:
Funmi Ogundare

The Publisher of Politico.ng, under the Political Intelligence Group, Lai Omotola, Thursday, projected President Bola Ahmed Tinubu as maintaining a slim lead over former Anambra State Governor, Peter Obi, and former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar ahead of the 2027 general election.

Omotola, who disclosed this while presenting the third edition of his November 2026 electoral map, in Lagos, explained that the presidential contest was becoming increasingly competitive, with changing voter preferences and the growing influence of young Nigerians expected to shape the outcome.

He projected that Obi would come second, while Atiku would occupy the third position, although the margin separating the three leading contenders remained narrow.

According to him, the political landscape has changed significantly, making it difficult for political parties to rely on previous electoral strategies and voting patterns.

He warned that politicians who approached the 2027 election with a business-as-usual mentality risked defeat.

“There are about 68 million new voters that will be voting for the first time in the 2027 elections, and the majority of these voters are youths. Unlike before, young people between the ages of 18 and 49 will dominate the election,” he stated.

Omotola also predicted that the 2027 general election could record the highest voter turnout in Nigeria’s electoral history, projecting participation of about 40 per cent, compared with the 29 per cent recorded in the last election.

In his state-by-state projection, he predicted that the All Progressives Congress (APC) would win 13 states, the New Democratic Congress (NDC) 13 states and the African Democratic Congress (ADC) 11 states.

He projected that the APC would dominate the South-west and North-central regions, while the NDC would win all states in the South-east and South-south, as well as Kano State and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT).

The ADC, according to him, would win states in the North-east and North-west, except Kano and Zamfara States.

He, however, stressed that the projections were based on the assumption that the 2027 elections would be free and fair.

Reviewing political developments in October, Omotola identified the commencement of campaigns by the three leading parties, the controversy surrounding the preliminary voters’ register released by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), and renewed debate over fuel subsidy as developments that could influence the electoral landscape.

He also cited the APC’s inaugural campaign in Kaduna, led by Tinubu, and Atiku’s proposal for the restoration of fuel subsidy as significant political and economic developments during the period.

Omotola expressed concern over the controversy surrounding the preliminary voters’ register, which he said had been affected by the inclusion of AI-generated names.

He further observed that opposition parties were encountering stiff resistance in their campaign activities, while internal disagreements within the APC could affect its electoral fortunes.

According to him, these developments could influence the three parties differently as political activities intensify ahead of the 2027 polls.

Omotola also identified political developments within opposition parties and the legal challenges confronting them as factors capable of changing the electoral projections before the election.

On the influence of religion in the 2027 election, the publisher said it remained a significant factor, particularly in northern Nigeria, where religious considerations continued to influence voter behaviour.

He interpreted Tinubu’s decision to retain his Muslim-Muslim ticket and his recent visit to Saudi Arabia as part of efforts to reinforce his religious credentials and appeal to northern voters.

He added that the north would play a decisive role in determining the outcome of the presidential election, noting that the contest would also test whether the region could maintain a united political position or become increasingly divided.

Omotola, however, cautioned that the electoral projections could change as political alignments, legal developments and campaign activities unfold.

He urged political parties, INEC and other stakeholders to prioritise peaceful, free and credible elections, describing the forthcoming poll as a defining moment for Nigeria’s democracy.

“This will be a turning point for Nigeria’s democracy, and the country will be a better place for it,” he said.

posts.title: 2027: Lawyers Seek Timely, Transparent Display of Voters’ Register
posts.excerpt: * Urge amendment of law requiring AG’s consent to enforce monetary judgment against government Alex Enumah As activities continue to gear up towards the conduct of the 2027 general election,
posts.content:
* Urge amendment of law requiring AG’s consent to enforce monetary judgment against government

Alex Enumah

As activities continue to gear up towards the conduct of the 2027 general election, legal practitioners in the country have called on the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to ensure the timely and transparent display of the voters’ register, so as to ensure the credibility of the polls.

The lawyers, who noted that electoral credibility begins before the polling day, stressed that accurate records, lawful procedures and meaningful public scrutiny are essential to public confidence.

This is just as they have called on the National Assembly to abolish the law requiring the consent of the Attorney-General to enforce monetary judgment against government.

The lawyers made the call on Thursday in Abuja, at an event marking the Law Corridor Founders’ Day, as well as the introduction of a Professor of Public and International Law, Prof. Olarenwaju A. Aladeitan, as a Partner of the Law Corridor.

Speaking at the occasion, the Managing Partner of Law Corridor, Henry Kelechi Eniotu, explained that under the Electoral Act 2026, while Section 19 addresses the display or publication of the voters’ register, Section 77 addresses political-party membership registers and their submission to INEC before primaries, congresses and conventions.

“INEC must clearly communicate the applicable timelines, provide accessible opportunities for voters to inspect their records and ensure effective procedures for claims, objections and corrections. It should also explain how compliance with party membership register requirements will be verified and enforced, subject to lawful safeguards for personal information.

“Publicly announced voter statistics must be clear and verifiable. The Commission should distinguish between applications received, completed registrations and the final number of eligible registered voters. Where figures change or credible discrepancies arise, it should provide timely explanations,” Eniotu said.

The lawyer further stated that political parties must equally maintain accurate records and comply with their statutory obligations, adding that the same standards must apply consistently to every party and candidate.

He stressed that public confidence grows when electoral procedures and information can withstand scrutiny.

Speaking on enforcement of monetary judgment against the government, the lawyers who argued that a judgment must provide an effective remedy, submitted that citizens who successfully establish their claims against public institutions should be able to obtain the benefits of those judgments without avoidable obstruction.

They observed that while Section 84 of the Sheriffs and Civil Process Act requires the consent of the appropriate Attorney-General before a garnishee order nisi may be made where the money sought to be attached is held by a public officer in an official capacity, the said requirement is subject to judicial interpretation.

According to them, “The continued existence of the consent requirement creates opportunities for delay in cases to which it applies.”

They alleged that successful litigants may spend years pursuing payment while their businesses suffer and inflation erodes the value of their judgments.

“Government has access to appeals and applications for a stay of execution. An executive officer should not possess an additional, indefinite power to obstruct enforcement against the government that officer represents.

“We therefore call on the National Assembly to abolish the Attorney-General’s consent requirement and establish clear enforcement procedures supported by definite timelines, responsible budgeting and judicial oversight.

“Government must respect the judicial authority it expects citizens to obey”, they said. Eniotu assured that the Law Corridor will continue to contribute its quota towards development of the country, through legal analysis, public-interest advocacy and constructive engagement with institutions responsible for reform.

“As we mark our Founders’ Week and welcome Professor Aladeitan into the partnership, we renew our commitment to professional excellence and meaningful service to society.

“We thank our clients for their trust, our colleagues for their dedication and the media for their contribution to public accountability,” Eniotu said.

Source: https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/05/2027-lawyers-seek-timely-transparent-display-of-voters-register/

posts.content:
* Congratulates team for historic qualification for cup final in Morocco

Deji Elumoye in Abuja

President Bola Tinubu has charged Nigeria’s U-17 women’s national football team, the Flamingos, to go for the gold as they meet Japan in the final of the 2026 Women’s World Cup in Morocco.

The president, in a release issued on Thursday by his Adviser on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga, told the young female footballers: “Nigeria is proud of you. Go for the trophy, Flamingos.”

As the Flamingos prepare to face Japan in the final, Tinubu urged the players to remain focused, confident and determined, assuring them of the prayers, goodwill and unflinching support of the Nigerian nation.

“I encourage you to approach the final with the same fighting spirit and belief that have brought you this far. I have confidence in your ability to make history by winning the coveted world title.

“I call on all Nigerians to rally behind the young ambassadors of the nation, whose achievements continue to showcase Nigeria’s sporting excellence and inspire a new generation of girls to pursue their dreams uninhibited.”

The president congratulated the Flamingos on their impressive victory over Brazil in Wednesday’s semi-final of the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup.

He described the team’s qualification for the final as a remarkable achievement that has brought immense pride and joy to millions of Nigerians at home and abroad.

Tinubu also applauded the coaching crew and all those whose hard work and support contributed to the team’s successful campaign.

Oyo State Governor and presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), Seyi Makinde, has blamed the economic hardship facing millions of Nigerians on what he described as inadequate planning by the President Bola Tinubu-led administration.

Makinde said major economic policy decisions introduced by the Federal Government were implemented without adequate plans and frameworks to cushion their effects on citizens, thereby worsening the economic difficulties faced by Nigerians.

The APM presidential candidate spoke on Friday during a live interview on the Bauchi Radio Corporation (BRC), while in Bauchi State to flag off his 2027 presidential campaign.

He argued that the immediate impact of the administration’s economic policies on Nigerians was a consequence of taking major decisions without adequate preparation and effective implementation strategies.

Makinde stressed that economic reforms must be supported by proper planning and clear implementation frameworks to ensure that ordinary citizens do not bear the brunt of government policies.

He said addressing the country’s economic challenges would require fundamental structural reforms and strong political will.

The Oyo governor also highlighted the APM’s Reset Nigeria Agenda, which he said was designed to address the country’s challenges through a documented policy framework and the party’s manifesto.

According to him, the agenda focuses on reforming critical sectors of the economy, promoting sustainable development and restoring true federalism that recognises and respects Nigeria’s diverse nationalities.

posts.title: 9 mystery fingerprints from OJ Simpson murder case could hold new clues more than 30 years later
posts.excerpt: Nine unidentified fingerprints from the Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman crime scene could now be retested using modern forensic technology.
posts.content:
Nine fingerprints that went unidentified during the original OJ Simpson murder investigation could hold new clues more than 30 years later — and one filmmaker believes advances in forensic technology could help reveal who left them behind.

Ari Mark co-directed the Peacock docuseries "OJ's Accomplice," which reexamines the 1994 murders of Simpson's ex-wife, Nicole Brown Simpson, and her friend, Ron Goldman. The series explores the theory that the former NFL star may not have acted alone, focusing on convicted drug trafficker and Simpson associate Joey Ippolito, who reportedly had ties to organized crime.

Mark told Fox News Digital he wants investigators to consider reexamining nine fingerprints recovered from the crime scene that could not be matched to any known samples during the original investigation.

NICOLE BROWN SIMPSON TOLD FORMER LOVER SHE'D 'RATHER DIE' THAN RETURN TO O.J. SIMPSON BEFORE HER MURDER

"The fact that there's nine fingerprints sitting around that nobody wants to put through a system that's very updated and technologically not what it was before, that just seems unnecessary," Mark said. "Just do it."

"You can take latent prints and analyze those in a way that you couldn't before," Mark continued. "Also, remember, the systems over time are obviously collecting more data and more people. So, if you're looking for a match, you have a greater chance of getting one all these years later."

In 1995, the Los Angeles Times reported that none of the identifiable fingerprints investigators collected at the Bundy Drive condominium where Brown Simpson and Goldman were murdered matched Simpson. Fingerprint specialist Gilbert Aguilar, a defense witness, testified that police knew that Simpson's fingerprints did not match the identifiable prints recovered at the crime scene.

Under questioning by lead defense attorney Johnnie Cochran Jr., Aguilar testified that nine prints found at Bundy Drive could not be matched to any known sample. According to the Los Angeles Times, Simpson's lawyers argued that unknown attackers committed the murders and that detectives failed to adequately investigate that possibility because they quickly concluded Simpson had killed his ex-wife and her friend.

WATCH: Kato Kaelin describes OJ Simpson encounter that raised suspicions

According to Aguilar's testimony, investigators compared the unidentified prints with those of Simpson, Brown Simpson and 58 friends, relatives and acquaintances, but found no matches. Aguilar also testified that investigators searched federal and state computerized fingerprint databases without finding a match.

Mark said his goal for the docuseries was "to raise enough questions that it gets a second look."

FOLLOW THE FOX TRUE CRIME TEAM ON X

"I'm very careful about the call to action because there are victims' families involved here and you would want them to be supportive of that," Mark said. "That would be my first priority. Assuming it was something they were interested in, I think everyone deserves to know what actually happened, and if that involves a second person, third person or whatever it is, great."

Aguilar, who appears in the docuseries, raised the possibility that today's expanded fingerprint databases could produce a match.

WATCH: Alan Dershowitz calls for independent OJ Simpson probe over lingering third-party questions

"At the crime scene, there were nine identifiable prints that I never identified to whom they belong," Aguilar said in the documentary. "Back in 1994, you're running prints through AFIS (Automated Fingerprint Identification System). But first, it's checking everybody that's been arrested by the Los Angeles Police Department. Then it would be run through Sacramento. Then run through all the Western states."

"If somebody is arrested outside your database, like in New York or the state of Florida, you’re not going to get anything," Aguilar continued. "LAPD has all the prints and they could have them [tested again]. They may or may not. I don’t know. It’s up to them now."

It is unclear whether investigators have reexamined the nine unidentified fingerprints using modern forensic technology or updated fingerprint databases.

An LAPD spokesperson told Fox News Digital that the investigation remains open.

SIGN UP TO GET THE LATEST TRUE CRIME NEWS

"The OJ Simpson case remains an open and ongoing investigation. The Department has an obligation to continue to pursue justice in this matter, at a point that, if new evidence is found, detectives will follow those investigatory leads. At this point there is no other information available for release."

In the docuseries, defense investigator Pat McKenna said the fingerprints should easily be sent to a lab for further analysis.

"This is like a door," he said. "Wide open. Don't you want to close that door? I would think they should want to do that. But I think they're afraid of what it would show."

According to the docuseries, the producers asked the Los Angeles County District Attorney's Office to have the unidentified fingerprints reexamined but received no response. Fox News Digital contacted the office for comment.

"I wouldn't put anything past technology," Mark said. "I think we all know that tech, it's just gotten so advanced, especially when it comes to forensics, that I believe something could be pulled from those fingerprints. Ideally, there'd be some sort of DNA that's been preserved, and the right type of reopening would force a reinvestigation of those materials."

"I feel very confident that if everyone was on the same page and we wanted to look at something objectively and see if there's any new truth there, we could do it," Mark added.

SIGN UP TO GET THE TRUE CRIME NEWSLETTER

The unidentified fingerprints are part of the docuseries' broader investigation into whether Simpson had an accomplice the night Brown Simpson and Goldman were killed.

Before the docuseries premiered, Joey Ippolito's brother, Sam Ippolito, told The New York Times that Joey returned to a Los Angeles apartment around midnight on June 12, 1994, carrying a bag containing a heavy object.

Sam said his brother appeared to have blood on his hands after leaving the apartment hours earlier to help a friend. According to Sam, Joey stuffed his clothes into the bag and instructed him to dispose of it while he showered. Sam Ippolito told the newspaper he tossed the bag into a dumpster near a construction site along Doheny Drive in Los Angeles. Sam shared a similar account in the docuseries.

GET REAL-TIME UPDATES DIRECTLY ON THE TRUE CRIME HUB

Sam's account has also faced questions about its credibility. According to The New York Times, he sought compensation from the newspaper and later attempted to retract his statements after the newspaper declined his request for payment. Friends and relatives have disputed suggestions that Ippolito participated in the murders.

Ippolito, who escaped from a Florida prison in May 1994, became a federal informant after his arrest in August 1995, while Simpson's nationally televised murder trial was nearing its conclusion. He died in 2006.

A December 1996 federal prosecution memorandum, unsealed at The New York Times' request, described Ippolito as a valuable source who possessed information about Simpson's alleged efforts to dispose of the murder weapon and his attempted flight from authorities.

LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE

Former federal prosecutor David Kelley described Ippolito in the memorandum as a "remarkable source of information" whose cooperation had proven valuable to investigators. Kelley later told The New York Times he did not believe Ippolito participated in the murders.

"My instinct is that not only did I feel that he was telling the truth, but I also felt that he had more to share," Mark said.

"I think The New York Times probably spooked him a bit because they are a big publication … But I really do believe him. I believed him then, I believe him now."

GET BREAKING NEWS BY EMAIL

Brown Simpson's sister, Tanya Brown, rejects the theory that Simpson had an accomplice. In the docuseries, Tanya Brown said she believes Simpson alone was responsible for her sister's murder.

"I think it's impossible if you're in her position to speculate about theories, and I don't blame her for that," Mark said. "Everything about her felt like the little sister of somebody who's an unfortunate victim."

Simpson and Brown Simpson married in 1985. They had two children, Sydney and Justin, and divorced in 1992. Two years later, Brown Simpson and Goldman were found stabbed to death.

SEND US A TIP

Investigators quickly focused on Simpson. Following the 1995 murder trial, he was acquitted of killing Brown Simpson and Goldman. In 1997, a civil jury found Simpson liable for their deaths. He later served nearly nine years in prison following his conviction on armed robbery and other charges stemming from an unrelated incident in Las Vegas. He died in April 2024 at age 76.

Fox News Digital’s Stephen Sorace contributed to this report.
